jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer H/F
jobs.description:
Le Groupe Santiane, appartenant au Groupe Kereis acteur majeur de l'emprunteur, est un courtier grossiste de référence en assurance santé, prévoyance, emprunteur, obsèques et IARD.

Courtier multi-canal et multi-spécialiste, nous combinons performance commerciale, excellence opérationnelle et innovation digitale pour générer une croissance rentable et accompagner la diversification de nos lignes de business.

Notre modèle hybride — entre courtage B2B2C et distribution directe B2C — nous permet d’innover et de transformer nos pratiques pour toujours mieux servir nos clients.

Derrière le Groupe Santiane, ce sont plus de 250 talents, répartis entre Nice, Paris et Reims, qui innovent chaque jour dans un environnement agile, collaboratif et en constante évolution.

Vous prenez en charge toute la chaîne de la donnée de la source à la visualisation (SQL, transformations, contrôles, revues, livraison).

Référent technique des ingénieurs data et rattaché hiérarchiquement au Responsable Data, avec qui vous participez aux différents choix, vous couvrez toute la chaîne de la donnée, de la source jusqu’à la visualisation : SQL, transformations, contrôles, relecture du travail des autres, livraison. Vous définissez les bonnes pratiques de modélisation, animez les revues de code SQL, veillez à la qualité et participez aux choix d’architecture avec le Responsable Data, dont l’équipe reste hiérarchiquement dépendante.

Olympus, notre produit data, lit vos tables à travers une couche sémantique : un catalogue qui décrit chaque indicateur une seule fois, de façon claire. Vous garantissez ce contrat (niveau de détail des données, définitions, fraîcheur) et vous intervenez sur le produit quand le sujet l'exige.

Vos Missions Principales Sont Les Suivantes

Porter un sujet data de A à Z : transformer un besoin métier (production, chute, précompte, gestion, finance…) en modèle de données, pipeline et table fiable.
Fiabiliser le parcours des données : contrats de schéma, synchronisation, suivi, chasse aux écarts (calculs, fuseaux horaires, jointures).
Aligner les KPI de Santiane et Kereis : définitions communes (brut, net, chute, production emprunteur), intégration de nouvelles sources (outils de gestion, flux EDI partenaires) avec historique, et cloisonnement strict entre entités.
Faire progresser l’équipe : animer les revues SQL, fixer les standards de pipeline, accompagner les juniors.
Remettre le chiffre en question : maîtriser les indicateurs (productivité, précompte, sinistralité, attribution) pour détecter un résultat faux.
Livrer la visualisation : construire la vue Olympus (tableau de bord, suivi, alerte) pour que le métier consulte un écran, pas un export.

Vous êtes un profil data senior, technique et autonome. Vous codez encore et vous n'êtes pas spécialiste d'un seul outil.

Vous n'avez jamais utilisé Dataiku ou Apache Doris ?

Ce n'est pas un problème : si vous maîtrisez des outils équivalents, vous prendrez en main notre environnement technique en quelques semaines. Nous recrutons un niveau, pas une liste d'outils.

Indispensable

Excellent SQL : jointures, fenêtres, agrégats, qualité de donnée. C'est le cœur du métier.
Python solide : pipelines, contrôles, et le code qui sert une visualisation.
Pipelines industrialisés avec un outil d'ETL ou d'orchestration (Dataiku DSS, dbt, Airflow, Dagster ou équivalent). Vous avez mis des flux en production, pas seulement lancé des notebooks.
Autonomie : vous cadrez le sujet, posez les bonnes questions et livrez sans qu'on ait besoin de vous relancer.
Expérience de référent technique/manager

Un plus

Une expérience d'un moteur analytique (OLAP), c'est-à-dire une base conçue pour analyser de gros volumes : Doris, StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino, Snowflake, BigQuery.
Une expérience en assurance, courtage ou finance.
Une expérience de convergence de systèmes d'information : réconciliation de référentiels, double run ().
Git, CI (intégration continue) et gestion des environnements.
Vous êtes à l'aise avec les assistants de code IA (Cursor ou équivalent) pour aller plus vite, sans leur déléguer votre jugement.

Rémunération et avantages

Rémunération

A partir de 60 000 euros bruts par an selon profil
Prime de participation

Avantages

Tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 11 euros pris en charge à 59% par l’employeur
Mutuelle de groupe (formule de base offerte pour le collaborateur)
Prise en charge à 100% des frais de transport en commun
Possibilité de faire du télétravail
Compte épargne temps

Cette opportunité est également accessible aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Location: Paris, France – hybrid

We are looking for two Senior Data Engineers to support the continued development and improvement of an established Consumer Data Platform.

The platform is built using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake and Microsoft Azure, and enables consumer data to support downstream marketing and customer-focused use cases.

With the main platform now established, the focus is on improving its quality, reliability and maintainability. This includes resolving technical debt, strengthening architecture, improving data pipelines and ensuring the platform can continue to scale.

This is a hands-on position for someone who takes ownership of technical challenges and proactively works with the wider team to deliver solutions.

Develop and improve data pipelines using Python and SQL
Build and maintain data transformations using dbt
Work with Snowflake and Azure-based data environments
Improve the reliability and performance of the Consumer Data Platform

Contribute to data architecture and technical design decisions
Investigate issues across upstream and downstream systems
Take ownership of technical problems through to resolution
Collaborate with engineers, architects and business stakeholders
Improve engineering standards, testing and software quality
Communicate blockers clearly and proactively seek solutions

Strong commercial experience as a Senior Data Engineer
Advanced Python and SQL skills
Hands-on experience with dbt
Strong Snowflake experience
Experience working within Microsoft Azure
Experience designing and developing modern data platforms

Ability to work independently and manage technical priorities
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
A proactive approach with clear evidence of ownership

The position is hybrid, with approximately one week per month required in Paris. This can potentially be divided into shorter blocks of on-site attendance.

jobs.title: Data Engineer for Clinical Data
jobs.description:
1 - Working at the VUB

For almost 50 years, the Vrije Universiteit Brussel
has stood for freedom, equality and connectedness. These values are strongly present on our campuses, in our students as well as our staff. At the VUB, you’ll find a diverse collection of personalities: pure innovators and especially people who are 100% their authentic selves
. With about 3.500 employees
, we are the largest Flemish-speaking employer in Brussels
, an international city with which we are all too happy to be connected, and around which our four campuses are located.

2 - Position Description

As a Data Engineer for clinical data, you will develop and operationalize the secure data and integration components that connect hospital research registries with environmental and socioeconomic data. You work closely with the UZ Brussels ICT department, supporting their clinical teams and VUB data scientists.

Project Context - BEE

BEE is an Innoviris Research Platform project studying how combinations of environmental exposures, socioeconomic factors and health characteristics influence cardiovascular, neurovascular and other non-communicable diseases in the Brussels-Capital Region. The project combines clinical and population data with environmental information and AI-based analysis. A core requirement is a privacy-preserving technical ecosystem that can securely and reproducibly enrich pseudonymized hospital records with exposomic data.

What Are You Going To Do

You contribute to the development of data-driven products: from the Clinical Data Warehouse to innovative applications of AI and Data Science.
As a Data Engineer, you are building a solid DataOps framework that supports the entire lifecycle of data-intensive products via data pipelines – from efficiently extracting data from various sources to smoothly operationalizing it in a production environment.
You will design and develop technically the REDCap integration framework around UZ Brussel's REDCap environment for secure handling of structured, unstructured, and non-textual research data.
You will contribute to the development of the novel VUB-UZ Brussel Digital Health Data Platform, which makes data available to various stakeholders (including for dashboards, AI, and machine learning analytics).
You will implement reliable interfaces and data pipelines between REDCap and the BEE server, including privacy-preserving geocoding and automated enrichment of patient records with environmental and socioeconomic data for defined locations and time windows.
You will collaborate with and support researchers, clinicians, data managers, IT engineers and data-protection stakeholders to refine requirements, resolve integration issues, support deployment and end-user adoption, and contribute to the REDCap Ecosystem and reference-architecture deliverables.

For this position, the Brussels Health Campus in Jette will be your work base.

3 - Profile

We are looking for an enthusiastic Data Engineer who recognizes themselves in the following characteristics:

Passion for ICT: You hold at least a bachelor's degree in a scientific IT-oriented field (engineering, computer science, sciences, …);
Experience: You preferably have a few years of relevant work experience in Data Engineering and Data Ops, and you know how best to utilize tools such as Docker, Git, Jenkins, and Prefect. Additionally, you have experience in an ETL / ELT environment, and setting up and managing a Data Warehouse / Data Lake is an advantage, as is familiarity with Microsoft Azure data services;
Programming: A good knowledge of programming in Python and SQL is a must;
Software design: You highly value good software design, and have applied this in concrete projects;
Clinical/research platforms: Experience with REDCap, electronic data-capture systems, research registries or hospital data environments is a strong asset;
Collaboration: You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can translate clinical/research needs into implementable technical solutions. You work effectively in a multidisciplinary team while also being able to work independently;;
Competencies: You are analytical, you have good communication skills, you are a team player, and you can also work well independently;
Compliance: You hold privacy and ethics in high regard.

4 - Offer

Are you going to be our new colleague? You’ll be offered a temporary full-time contract (1 year) at a salary linked to Grades 5 or 6, depending on your competences and previous relevant work experience.

Benefits

At the VUB, you’re guaranteed an open, involved and diverse workplace where you are offered opportunities to (further) build on your career. As well as this, you’ll enjoy various benefits:

Full reimbursement for your home-work commute with public transport according to VUB-policy, or compensation if you come by bike;
Cost-free hospitalisation and group insurance with guaranteed income;
The space to form your job content and continuously learn via VUB LRN;
Excellent facilities for sport and exercise;
Ecocheques;
Delicious meals at attractive prices in our campus restaurants;
An open, family-friendly work environment where attention is paid to work-life balance, and exceptional holiday arrangements with 35 days of leave (based on a fulltime contract).

5 - Interested?

Is this the job you’ve been dreaming of? Apply before 19/10/2026. Send us your CV, letter of motivation and the highest degree you’ve attained
(not applicable for VUB alumni).

Your Application Will Undergo Various Steps As Follows

Step 1: CV screening by one of our recruiters.
Step 2: A practical exam on our campus; at this moment, this is scheduled for the week of October 26 (although we reserve the right to change the date).
Step 3: A final interview will be scheduled in consultation with the candidate.

Do you have questions about the job content? Contact Prof. Pieter Cornu at pieter.cornu@vub.be

Do you have questions about the selection procedure? Contact Mrs. Natasja Amys at natasja.amys@vub.be

Would you like to know what it’s like to work at the VUB?

Go to www.jobs.vub.be
and find all there is to know about our campuses, benefits, strategic goals and your future colleagues.

6 - For office use

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (F/H)
jobs.description:
Dans un contexte de forte croissance et d’investissement sur les sujets Data & IA, Groupe Premium poursuit la structuration de sa plateforme data afin de renforcer les capacités de pilotage, d’optimisation opérationnelle et de valorisation de la donnée au sein du pôle Courtage. 

Rattaché(e) directement au Head of Data & IA
, vous rejoignez une équipe Data & IA en pleine accélération et participerez à la construction de la plateforme data qui soutient les activités commerciales, opérationnelles et de pilotage du pôle Courtage. 

Vous travaillez en proximité avec les équipes métiers, les PMOs, et les équipes applicatives pour concevoir, développer et industrialiser les flux alimentant les usages de pilotage, de reporting, de conformité et les futurs cas d’usage IA du Courtage. 

Au-delà du développement de pipelines, nous recherchons un(e) Senior Data Engineer capable de contribuer aux choix techniques, de challenger les besoins et d’avoir un impact concret sur la construction de notre écosystème data. 

Vos missions principales 

Concevoir et industrialiser les flux de données 

Concevoir, développer et maintenir les pipelines d’alimentation depuis les systèmes sources du pôle Courtage. 

Participer aux choix d’architecture de la plateforme data et à la définition des standards techniques. 

Concevoir et implémenter les règles de transformation et de contrôle des données. 

Optimiser les performances des traitements et la gestion des volumes de données. 

Garantir la robustesse, la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des flux en production. 

Modéliser, exposer et activer les données 

Participer à la conception des modèles de données répondant aux besoins métiers. 

Construire les tables, vues, jeux de données et couches de restitution nécessaires aux usages analytiques. 

Accompagner les Data Analysts dans l’exploitation et la valorisation des données. 

Challenger les besoins métiers et proposer les solutions techniques les plus adaptées. 

Contribuer à la mise à disposition d’un socle de données fiable pour les usages de pilotage, de reporting et les futurs cas d’usage IA du pôle Courtage. 

Concevoir et industrialiser l’activation des données dans les outils tiers : CRM, plateformes marketing, outils opérationnels, applications métiers et APIs. 

Veiller à la fiabilité, à la sécurité, à la traçabilité et au suivi des flux sortants vers ces outils. 

Garantir la qualité, l’observabilité et la maîtrise des coûts 

Mettre en œuvre les contrôles de qualité, de cohérence et de complétude des données. 

Participer à l’amélioration continue de la qualité des référentiels et des données métiers. 

Développer les mécanismes de monitoring, d’observabilité et d’alerting. 

Contribuer aux analyses d’incidents et aux plans de remédiation. 

Mettre en place le suivi de la consommation et des coûts de la plateforme data, notamment des capacités Microsoft Fabric et des services Azure associés. 

Identifier et mettre en œuvre les leviers d’optimisation permettant de maîtriser les coûts sans dégrader le niveau de service. 

Produire et partager des indicateurs de suivi sur la performance, l’usage et les coûts de la plateforme. 

Développer les pratiques DataOps 

Utiliser et faire évoluer les pratiques Git, CI/CD et les standards d’industrialisation. 

Automatiser les déploiements et les processus récurrents. 

Documenter les architectures, flux, pipelines, modèles de données et interfaces. 

Participer aux revues de code et à la diffusion des bonnes pratiques au sein de l’équipe Data. 

Contribuer à la stratégie Data & IA du pôle Courtage 

Participer à la construction des fondations techniques qui permettront le développement des futurs cas d’usage IA du pôle Courtage. 

Assurer une veille sur les nouvelles pratiques Data Engineering, Microsoft Fabric, DataOps et IA. 

Être force de proposition sur les améliorations techniques et organisationnelles de la plateforme. 

Votre environnement 

Microsoft Fabric et OneLake 

Lakehouse et Data Warehouse 

SQL, Python et PySpark 

Git, Azure DevOps et pratiques CI/CD 

Power BI 

APIs, connecteurs et mécanismes d’activation de données 

Monitoring, observabilité et suivi des coûts cloud 

Profil recherché :

Expérience 

Au moins 5 ans d’expérience sur des fonctions de Data Engineering, Data Platform ou Analytics Engineering. 

Expérience significative dans la conception, la construction et l’industrialisation de pipelines de données. 

Expérience de l’exploitation d’une plateforme data en production, incluant la supervision de ses performances et de ses coûts. 

Une expérience dans les secteurs de la finance, de l’assurance ou des services réglementés constitue un plus. 

Compétences techniques 

Très bonne maîtrise de SQL. 

Bonne maîtrise de Python et PySpark. 

Expérience concrète sur Microsoft Fabric et Azure. 

Maîtrise de Git, Azure DevOps et des pratiques CI/CD. 

Solides compétences en modélisation de données dimensionnelle et relationnelle. 

Bonne compréhension des architectures Lakehouse et Data Warehouse. 

Expérience des mécanismes d’échange et d’activation de données : APIs, webhooks, connecteurs, fichiers sécurisés ou reverse ETL. 

Connaissance des enjeux de sécurité, de gouvernance, de qualité et de traçabilité des données. 

Expérience dans la mise en place de mécanismes de monitoring, d’observabilité et de suivi des coûts cloud. 

Soft skills 

Autonomie et capacité à prendre des initiatives. 

Esprit analytique, pragmatique et orienté impact. 

Capacité à challenger un besoin et à proposer des solutions adaptées. 

Excellentes capacités de communication avec des interlocuteurs techniques et métiers. 

Goût pour le travail en équipe, la revue de code et la transmission des bonnes pratiques. 

Curiosité forte pour les sujets Data, IA et automatisation. 

Conditions

Localisation : Boulogne-Billancourt

Rémunération : 60 à 70k€ selon profil

Statut : Cadre

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Participer à la construction d’une plateforme data stratégique pour l’activité Courtage de Groupe Premium. 

Rejoindre une équipe Data & IA à taille humaine où les décisions se prennent rapidement. 

Bénéficier d’un impact direct et visible sur les projets livrés aux métiers. 

Être au contact des équipes opérationnelles et des décideurs. 

Intervenir sur toute la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, de l’ingestion jusqu’à son activation dans les outils métiers. 

Contribuer à des projets mêlant Data, automatisation et intelligence artificielle. 

Évoluer dans un environnement où beaucoup reste à construire et où votre expertise contribuera directement à définir les standards techniques de demain.

Entretien technique avec notre Data lead responsable de l'équipe
Dernière échange avec la direction

L’agence lyonnaise est composée de 350 collaborateurs répartis en communautés d’experts. Devoteam Lyon accompagne les DSI dans leur transformation digitale, avec un focus sur les nouvelles technologies comme le cloud (AWS, Microsoft, Google), l'intelligence artificielle, la cybersécurité, la data, et l'automatisation des processus métiers.

Notre ambition est de repousser les limites de l’innovation pour les organisations confrontées aux enjeux technologiques actuels, en tirant parti des plateformes cloud pour tester rapidement de nouvelles idées et innover de façon agile et optimisée.

Pour développer l’activité AWS au sein de la Squad A cloud, nous recherchons un(e) Consultant(e) Senior Data Engineer AWS

Description Du Poste

Vos Missions au Quotidien ☁️

Accompagner les métiers dans le cadrage et le delivery de leurs cas d’usage data.
Industrialiser et assurer le run des pipelines de traitement de données en production.
Encadrer et accompagner les profils plus juniors dans leur montée en compétences.
Être force de proposition auprès du client pour faire évoluer sa plateforme data.
Concevoir et animer des présentations techniques afin de partager votre expertise avec les collaborateurs.
Participer à la tenue d’entretiens techniques pour contribuer à la croissance du collectif.
Intervenir en shadow sur des avant-ventes pour aider à la conception de solutions techniques destinées à nos futurs clients.

Qualifications

Vos Atouts pour Réussir ✨

Vous disposez d’une solide maîtrise de Python, Git, SQL ainsi que d’au moins une librairie dédiée au traitement de données (Pandas, Polars, Dask, Spark…).
Vous avez une bonne compréhension des architectures data et de leurs enjeux : SQL vs NoSQL, OLTP vs OLAP, ACID vs BASE, Batch vs Streaming, Datalake vs Data Warehouse vs Lakehouse.
Vous avez déjà travaillé sur l’écosystème AWS (ou un autre hyperscaler comme Azure ou GCP) et vous êtes à l’aise avec Spark pour le traitement distribué de données.
Vous avez une expérience concrète en mise en production et en run de pipelines de données, et vous connaissez les outils d’orchestration comme Airflow ou Dagster.
Vous appliquez au quotidien les méthodes Agiles et êtes capable d’évoluer dans un contexte collaboratif.
Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation supérieure en informatique ou équivalent.
Bonus : vous maîtrisez les concepts de modélisation de données, les optimisations Spark, ou avez déjà travaillé sur des plateformes data managées comme Snowflake, Databricks ou DBT. Une expérience sur l’Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) ou les outils de CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) serait également un vrai plus.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre :

Nous sommes une IA-Driven Company : Né lors des prémices de la révolution tech, Devoteam est le partenaire de confiance qui a accompagné ses clients vers l'évolution d'Internet, du Cloud, et désormais, de la révolution de l'IA. Pour cela, 100% de nos collaborateurs sont certifiés GenAI. Rejoindre Devoteam, c’est apprendre en continu. Avec 75% de collaborateurs certifiés, Devoteam est une Learning Company où l’apprentissage est au cœur de notre modèle. Avec 50 tribus d’expertise composées de leaders technologiques, nous collaborons avec les plus grands partenaires technologiques : Google, AWS, Microsoft, ServiceNow, Snowflake, et bien d’autres. Ce collectif d’experts contribue à animer nos communautés métiers et à présenter chaque année son point de vue sur les technologies via le Tech Radar.

Informations supplémentaires

👉🏻 Avantages

Pour faire de notre collaboration un succès, nous vous proposons :

🤓 Un compte AWS dédié par consultant pour expérimenter au gré de votre imagination
💶 Intéressement et participation
📈 Une trajectoire sur mesure que nous élaborons ensemble
🎓 Des accès gratuits et illimités à des plateformes E-learning pour monter en compétences sur les technos que vous jugez prometteuses (Udemy / Cloud Guru / WhizLabs)
🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible avec remboursement de certains frais
🏋️ Un abonnement Gymlib (et donc une multitude de choix pour faire du sport à petit prix !)
💻 Laptop au choix (Mac ou Windows)

Talent Acquisition Interview : l'objectif est de faire le point sur vos compétences, votre niveau d'anglais et de valider vos éléments de motivation,
Tech & Business Interview : cet entretien vise à approfondir vos compétences techniques et à vérifier leur adéquation avec nos besoins lors d'un échange avec un expert métier,
Leadership Interview : il permet d'évaluer votre potentiel, vos ambitions et d'envisager votre évolution au sein de Devoteam.

Nous privilégions au moins un entretien en présentiel. Une prise de référence est demandée et, selon votre profil, des tests (techniques, anglais, personnalité...) peuvent vous être adressés.

Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous faisons parvenir une proposition présentant les conditions d'embauche. En cas d'acceptation, le contrat de travail est formalisé.

Le Groupe Devoteam œuvre pour l'égalité des chances, pour la promotion de ses collaboratrices et de ses collaborateurs au mérite et lutte activement contre toute forme de discrimination. Nous sommes persuadés que la diversité contribue à la créativité, au dynamisme et à l'excellence de notre organisation. Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Job Description

🚀 Ready to turn data into business superpowers?

Hey there 👋! We're Bizzy - and we're on a mission to build an AI Sales OS that gives sales and marketing teams superpowers to spot opportunities, create interest and close deals.

We're scaling fast, and to power our next phase of growth, we're looking for a Data Engineer who's not just into clean code, but into clean, powerful, business-changing data. You've had your first real years in data engineering, you've shipped pipelines that people depend on, and now you want to grow faster in a team that will give you real ownership.

If that sounds like you - keep reading. You might be exactly who we're looking for.

📍 Based in Ghent, with flexibility to work from home 2 days a week.

🔥 What You'll Be Doing

Build the backbone – Build and maintain the data pipelines that keep our platform fresh, working alongside senior engineers on design.
Connect the dots – Integrate diverse data sources like public registers, trade data, and intent signals into one powerful stream of insights.
Keep it clean – write the tests, checks and monitoring that keep our data reliable, and help shape how we do quality.
Help shape the big picture – Influence key data infrastructure decisions and help leadership make strategic, data-driven choices.
Automate the boring stuff – Create tools to monitor, transform, and validate data so we can focus on what matters.
Use AI smartly – Explore how AI and ML can enhance our data pipelines, improve data quality, and unlock new insights at scale.
Learn and multiply – Learn from experienced engineers through code reviews and pairing, and share what you pick up with the team. #UnitedByGrowth

Job Requirements

💡 What makes you a great fit

Hands-on data engineer – Around 3 years of experience in data engineering, or a close role such as analytics or backend engineering with a data focus. You've built and run pipelines in production..
Solid foundations of the modern data stack – Strong in Python and SQL, with experience on at least one cloud platform (Google Cloud is a plus). Spark or Databricks experience is a bonus, not a requirement. You'll learn our stack here.
Pipeline builder – You've built ETL/ELT pipelines and you care about reliability, performance and code someone else can maintain.
AI-curious & future-focused – You actively explore how AI and machine learning can improve data processes. You know when to experiment and when to ship.
Quality-obsessed – Testing and monitoring are part of how you build, and you want to learn how to do them at scale.
People-first mindset – You ask for feedback, give it honestly and share what you learn. #CandidCandor
Business-aware – You understand that great data engineering isn't just about technology — it's about enabling the business to make smarter, faster decisions.
Startup-ready – Fast-paced environments excite you. You embrace change, tackle challenges head-on, and know how to prioritize what truly matters. Strong ownership and a bias for action are in your DNA.
Fluent in English – Dutch is a bonus, but not a must.

✨ Why you'll love working with us

At Bizzy, we grow together — by learning fast, sharing openly, and challenging each other with Candid Candor. We believe in honest conversations that move us forward, not in circles.

We take initiative, act boldly, and Lead the Way — not by talking about it, but by doing it. We back each other up, celebrate wins together, and stay United by Growth, every step of the way.

Yes, we hustle. But we also know when to pause, recharge, and Unwind — because sustainable pace beats constant rush.

Joining Bizzy means joining a team that's shaping the future of sales tech across Europe. If you're ready to make your mark and grow fast, we'd love to meet you.

On top of a competitive salary, we offer the following benefits:

🛠️ The right tools to do your job without headaches and drama;
💻 MacBook Pro
📱iPhone (with subscription)

🏥 Healthcare benefits plan (incl Alan daily care)

👴🏻 Pension saving plan
🕛 Flexible working hours and locations, although we love to connect in person at least 3 days per week

🍏 Fresh fruit in the office (and cookies as well 🤫)
🧑‍🎓 Dedicated budget to support your growth and development
🎁 Awesome Bizzy merchandise
🍺 🎉 🏂 Team drinks and events

🌈 Diverse teams build better products. That starts with you.

Don't meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We actively want to hear from people of all backgrounds — even (especially) if you're unsure you tick every box. Confidence gaps and imposter syndrome hold too many great people back. Don't let that be you.

jobs.title: Data engineer voor klinische data
jobs.description:
HEB JE NOG VRAGEN OVER DEZE VACATURE?

Je vindt de gegevens van de contactpersoon in de vacaturetekst.

1 - Werken bij de VUB

Ben jij onze Data engineer voor klinische data
die graag de tanden zet in klinische data
en uitkijkt naar een volgende stap in je loopbaan?

VUB is steeds op zoek naar nieuw talent
om samen mee te groeien.

De Vrije Universiteit Brussel
staat al meer dan 50 jaar voor vrijheid, gelijk(waardig)heid en verbondenheid en dat leeft sterk op onze campussen bij zowel studenten als personeel. Bij de VUB vind je een diverse verzameling aan persoonlijkheden: innovators pur sang, maar vooral mensen die 100% hun authentieke zelf zijn
. Met zo’n 4000 medewerkers
zijn we de grootste Nederlandstalige werkgever, in de privésector, in Brussel;
een internationale stad waarmee we ons maar al te graag verbinden en waar(rond) onze 4 campussen gelegen zijn.

De VUB is bovendien lid van EUTOPIA
, een alliantie van 10 gelijkgestemde Europese universiteiten, alle tien klaar om zichzelf opnieuw uit te vinden.

2 - Functiebeschrijving

Als Data Engineer voor klinische data ontwikkel en operationaliseer je de beveiligde data- en integratiecomponenten die ziekenhuisonderzoeksregisters koppelen aan omgevings- en socio-economische gegevens. Je werkt nauw samen met de ICT-afdeling van UZ Brussel, ter ondersteuning van hun klinische teams en de datawetenschappers van de VUB.

Projectcontext – BEE

BEE is een Innoviris Onderzoeksplatform-project dat onderzoekt hoe combinaties van omgevingsblootstellingen, socio-economische factoren en gezondheidskenmerken cardiovasculaire, neurovasculaire en andere niet-overdraagbare aandoeningen beïnvloeden in het Brussels Hoofdstedelijk Gewest. Het project combineert klinische en populatiegegevens met omgevingsinformatie en AI-gebaseerde analyse. Een kernvereiste is een privacybeschermend technisch ecosysteem dat op een veilige en reproduceerbare manier gepseudonimiseerde ziekenhuisgegevens kan verrijken met exposoomdata.

Wat Ga Je Doen

Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van datagedreven producten: van het Clinical Data Warehouse tot innovatieve toepassingen van AI en Data Science.
Als Data Engineer bouw je een solide DataOps-framework dat de volledige levenscyclus van data-intensieve producten ondersteunt via datapijplijnen - van het efficiënt ontsluiten van data uit diverse bronnen tot het vlot operationaliseren ervan in een productieomgeving.
Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt technisch het REDCap-integratieframework rond de REDCap-omgeving van UZ Brussel, voor de beveiligde verwerking van gestructureerde, ongestructureerde en niet-tekstuele onderzoeksdata.
Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van het nieuwe VUB-UZ Brussel Digital Health Data Platform, dat data beschikbaar stelt aan uiteenlopende stakeholders (onder meer voor dashboards, AI en machine learning-analyses).
Je implementeert betrouwbare interfaces en datapijplijnen tussen REDCap en de BEE-server, inclusief privacybeschermende geocodering en geautomatiseerde verrijking van patiëntgegevens met omgevings- en socio-economische data voor bepaalde locaties en tijdsvensters.
Je werkt samen met en ondersteunt onderzoekers, clinici, datamanagers, IT-engineers en stakeholders rond gegevensbescherming om vereisten te verfijnen, integratieproblemen op te lossen, implementatie en adoptie door eindgebruikers te ondersteunen, en bij te dragen aan de deliverables van het REDCap-ecosysteem en de referentiearchitectuur.

Voor deze functie zal de Brussels Health Campus in Jette je thuisbasis worden.

3 - Profiel

We zijn op zoek naar een enthousiaste Data Engineer die zich herkent in de volgende kenmerken:

Passie voor ICT: Je beschikt minstens over een bachelor diploma in een wetenschappelijk IT-gerichte richting (ingenieurswetenschappen, informatica, wetenschappen, …);
Ervaring: Je hebt bij voorkeur enkele jaren relevante werkervaring in Data Engineering en Data Ops, en je weet hoe je tools zoals Docker, Git, Jenkins en Prefect optimaal inzet. Daarnaast heb je ervaring in een ETL-/ELT-omgeving, en is het opzetten en beheren van een Data Warehouse/Data Lake een pluspunt, net als vertrouwdheid met Microsoft Azure-datadiensten;
Programmeren: Een goede kennis van programmeren in Python en SQL is een must;
Softwareontwerp: Je hecht veel waarde aan goed softwareontwerp en hebt dit al toegepast in concrete projecten;
Klinische/onderzoeksplatformen: Ervaring met REDCap, elektronische datacaptatiesystemen, onderzoeksregisters of ziekenhuisdataomgevingen is een sterke troef;
Samenwerking: Je communiceert helder met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders en kan klinische/onderzoeksbehoeften vertalen naar implementeerbare technische oplossingen. Je werkt effectief in een multidisciplinair team, maar bent ook in staat om zelfstandig te werken;
Competenties: Je bent analytisch, beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden, bent een teamplayer, en kan ook goed zelfstandig werken;
Compliance: Je hecht veel belang aan privacy en ethiek.

4 - Aanbod

Word jij onze nieuwe collega? 

Dan bieden we je een contract van bepaalde duur (1 jaar) aan met een salaris gekoppeld aan graad 5 of 6, afhankelijk van je competenties en eerdere relevante werkervaring.

Bij De VUB Garanderen We Een Open, Betrokken En Diverse Werkplek En Geven We Je Kansen Om Je Loopbaan (verder) Uit Te Bouwen. Daarnaast Geniet Je Van Voordelen Als

Een open informele werkomgeving met aandacht voor je work-life balance, een uitzonderlijke verlofregeling met 35 verlofdagen, sluiting tussen Kerstmis en Nieuwjaar en 3 extra verlofdagen;
Een kosteloze hospitalisatie- en zeer mooie groepsverzekering met gewaarborgd inkomen; 
Maximale terugbetaling woon-werkverkeer met het openbaar vervoer en/of een fietsvergoeding;

jobs.description:
Job Description

adesso Belgium, who are we?
We are an IT (start-up) provider working under the adesso umbrella with proven track record in different industries. The new Belgian entity of adesso
is part of the expansion and growth strategy of the adesso group. With more than 10.000 employees spread over 60 locations we are entering an exciting period with our presence in Brussels, the capital of Europe.

We are looking for different freelance MS Fabric engineers for the staffing of different projects.

Job Requirements

As a Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer at adesso, you design and build modern data platforms on top of the Microsoft Fabric
ecosystem. You’ll work with the Fabric Lakehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks and Power BI to deliver robust, scalable and user‑friendly data solutions that enable our clients to become truly data‑driven.

Your Role In Projects

Design & build Fabric‑based data platforms

Design and implement Lakehouse architectures in Microsoft Fabric, using OneLake, Lakehouses and medallion (bronze‑silver‑gold) patterns.
Build reliable batch (and where relevant streaming) data pipelines using Fabric Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2 and integration with Azure data services.
Model data for analytics use cases in Power BI (star schema, semantic models) and for advanced analytics in Lakehouses.

Ingest, transform & govern data

Ingest data from APIs, flat files, on‑premises and cloud databases, and SaaS sources into OneLake / Lakehouses.
Implement clear and testable transformation logic (data quality checks, deduplication, SCD, CDC, business rules) using Notebooks, SQL, Dataflows Gen2 or Warehouse features.
Apply data governance best practices (workspaces, roles, sensitivity labels, lineage, RBAC) across Fabric.

Collaborate with Data & AI teams

Work closely with data analysts, analytics engineers, data scientists and BI developers to make data discoverable and usable.
Expose data to end‑users through Power BI datasets, semantic models and reports built on top of Fabric.
Support advanced analytics / ML workloads by preparing and structuring data within the Fabric environment.

Operate & optimize

Set up CI/CD and deployment pipelines for Fabric assets (Power BI, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Datasets) using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub.
Monitor and optimize data pipelines, storage and workloads for performance, reliability and cost.
Help define and implement best practices, coding standards and reusable components for Fabric within the team.

Contribute to the Data & AI community

Actively share knowledge within the Belgian and Dutch Data & AI community at adesso (brown‑bag sessions, internal talks, blogs, PoCs).
Contribute to proposals and pre‑sales activities, helping shape new Microsoft Fabric engagements.
Coach and mentor colleagues, especially around the transition from “classic” Azure/Power BI stacks to Fabric‑based architectures.

Required Technical Skills & Knowledge

Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Apache Spark, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake, Python, PySpark, SQL

Your profile

Technical Skills

Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Fabric or a strong background in the Azure + Power BI ecosystem and the ambition to specialize in Fabric.
Good programming skills in SQL and preferably Python (for Notebooks and data engineering workloads).
Strong understanding of data modeling for analytics (star schema / dimensional modeling; data vault or 3NF is a plus).
Experience building data warehouses / data marts or analytical data stores that serve BI and reporting needs.
Familiarity with Azure data services like Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake or similar tools is a strong plus.
Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and software engineering best practices (version control, testing, code reviews).
Understanding of data governance, security and compliance in the Microsoft cloud (RBAC, sensitivity labels, PII handling).

Consulting & Soft Skills

You enjoy talking to stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating them into pragmatic data solutions.
You can explain complex technical topics in a clear and approachable way, adapted to your audience.
You are comfortable working in multidisciplinary teams (data engineers, data scientists, cloud engineers, domain experts).
You are proactive, hands‑on, and take ownership of the solutions you build.
You are native Dutch or French speaking and fluent in ENG (both written & spoken)
This position requires current residency and work authorization in Belgium; relocation from other continents cannot be accommodated.

Why join adesso Belgium?

Work in an international group with strong local expertise in Belgium.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver trusted, compliant, reusable data products.
Flexible freelance setup with the support of a growing adesso Belgium community.

jobs.description:
🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. Random delays, confusing rules, extra apps and accounts make it harder than it should be to pay and get paid.

The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet that makes payments easier, clearer and more secure. Online, in store, at home and across borders, with money and data protected under European laws and regulations.

Wero is live in Belgium, France and Germany and launching soon in Luxembourg and the Netherlands. Backed by 16 major banks and the two largest European acquirers, we are building a brand-new, proudly European payment system. Why not join us?

🔎 What’s In It For You

Work on critical payment, settlement and consumer data products that support a growing European payment system.
Help shape a modern, governed lakehouse platform used for reporting, product analytics, fraud, finance and operational decision-making.
Build reliable data foundations in a regulated, high-trust environment where privacy, resilience and auditability matter.

At EPI, we embrace a remote-first culture, enabling our teams to work remotely from the country where they are based, with in-person meetings at least once a quarter to foster collaboration and connection.

🐝 About The Team

You will join the Data & Analytics team, reporting to Flora Stagnaro, Data Analytics Manager
.

You will work with a high degree of autonomy within the technical direction set by the Technical Lead. You will collaborate across analytics, backend, fraud, finance, product and platform teams to deliver dependable, reusable and governed data products.

💥 Your impact

Design, build and maintain reliable batch and near-real-time pipelines for payments, settlement, consumer and other critical data domains.
Ingest and model data from operational systems, event stores and third-party sources into EPI’s lakehouse.
Define and enforce data contracts covering schemas, ownership, quality expectations, freshness SLAs and breaking-change procedures.
Implement orchestration, scheduling, retries, monitoring, alerting, reconciliation and incident response for production-grade, idempotent workflows.
Apply governance and privacy-by-design principles, including PII classification, access controls, retention and auditability in line with GDPR, PSD2, DORA and internal requirements.
Build reusable tooling, templates, CI/CD workflows and secure deployment patterns for teams delivering data products.
Optimise storage, compute, query performance and materialisation strategies, contributing to cloud cost governance.
Collaborate with product, analytics, backend, fraud, finance and platform teams, documenting key technical and data decisions.

💻 Technology stack

Primary

Databricks platform - workspaces, jobs/workflows, DLT, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake
Transformation - dbt
Languages - SQL, Python
Deployment & CI/CD —-Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs), GitHub Actions
Infrastructure - Terraform and EPI's deployment patterns

Secondary

AWS, including S3, IAM and relevant networking fundamentals
Event-store and Kafka-based ingestion patterns, including schema evolution
Data quality and observability frameworks
Compute tagging, workload efficiency and resource attribution
Jira, Confluence and Slack

🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements

Must have

8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, backend data systems or a closely related role, with strong SQL and solid Python skills for production pipelines.
Production experience with Databricks or an equivalent lakehouse platform, including governance, scheduling, deployment and Delta Lake design, as well as dbt modelling, testing, documentation and DAG management.
Hands-on experience with orchestration, CI/CD and deployment automation, plus designing data contracts, schema validation, freshness SLAs and ownership boundaries.
Strong data governance and privacy-by-design knowledge, ideally in fintech, payments, banking or another regulated sector, with experience in monitoring, data quality and incident response.
Ability to turn ambiguous business requirements into dependable, reusable data products and governed metrics
Fluent English (CEFR C1 or C2) and confidence communicating asynchronously in a distributed European team.

Nice to have

Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka or equivalent event-store patterns, including schema registries.
Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience, containerised deployment patterns, and data observability or custom quality frameworks.
Databricks or AWS certifications

🎓 Qualifications and seniority

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally considered.
Senior Data Engineer level, equivalent to IC3–IC4, with around 5–8 years of experience.

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

A first call with one of our recruiters.
A technical interview focused on data engineering expertise with Flora Stagnaro and Mathias Peters.
A discussion-based system design and case interview with Mathias Peters and Davy Osamulia. You will design a resilient payments data pipeline; there is no take-home exercise.

Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse.

You prefer a highly structured environment with no ambiguity or do not enjoy working autonomously in a distributed team.

Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year.
Competitive compensation package, featuring salary, performance-based bonus and a thoughtfully designed, high-quality benefits programme.
The opportunity to be part of a pan-European company shaping the future of European payments.

Otherwise, apply!

jobs.description:
We're a startup moving as fast as possible, willing to make mistakes and course-correct, with the ambition to build the best product on the market.
At Reverse Contact, we build the B2B identity resolution API for modern software companies. We help B2B products, SaaS companies, AI tools, and data teams resolve professional identities from fragmented signals: emails, social media URLs, names, domains, IP addresses, phone numbers, and more.
Data is at the core of everything we do. Our systems process and maintain over a billion data points, and keeping that volume accurate, up to date, and instantly queryable is both one of the most challenging and most exciting parts of the job.
Based in the heart of Paris, in the 3rd arrondissement, our team of 12 is split across Tech (4), Data (1), Product (1), Sales (3), CS (1), Ops (1), and the CEO.
Context

We're hiring a junior data engineer, with a start date planned for January 2027, to support our data engineer and take ownership of our entire existing data stack, helping us structure and grow this function.
Our tech stack:
TypeScript, Bun.js, Supabase, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Python, PySpark, Databricks, Snowflake, S3, Metabase, and Claude Code.
Mission

Progressively take ownership of our existing data platform, becoming autonomous on topics currently handled by our data engineer and our QA.

Automate and industrialize data pipelines (ingestion, transformation) to reduce manual work and ensure reliable delivery.

Work with the product team to answer business queries, turning business questions into reliable data answers.

Build and document an end-to-end data quality control pipeline, giving the team a reliable, up-to-date view of production data.

Be proactive on cross-functional projects and/or data science topics (classification, internal use cases), depending on your interests and appetite to grow the scope of the role.

Hard Skills At least 1 year of experience as a data engineer, ideally in a production environment with reliability and scaling challenges. You've already designed or evolved ingestion and transformation pipelines, and you're comfortable navigating a modern data stack.

Strong command of SQL, with the ability to write and optimize complex queries on large data volumes, with a focus on performance and reliability of analytical processing.

Solid Python practice for building robust data processing pipelines, from raw collection through to delivery to business teams.

Soft Skills Conversational English required. We have several English-speaking team members.

Curiosity along with strong written and verbal communication.

Comfortable in a fast-moving startup environment.

Nice-to-have Knowledge of ClickHouse

Prior experience in data science

Experience with API-first products

Benefits

Base salary + variable + equity (TBD): 35k to 38k + ~ 4k bonus

The opportunity to join a startup with significant day-to-day ownership of data, direct and visible impact, and a possible path toward a senior role. No fixed trajectory.

2 days of remote work per week, with a lot of flexibility in how you organize your time and the possibility of remote work during certain periods of the year depending on your needs.

Hiring Process

Chief of Staff — intro call

VP Engineering + Data Engineer — general discussion

Asynchronous technical test

Fit interview with the team (in office)

Reference is optional.
Details:
35-hour contract, choice of work equipment, Alan health insurance, ~€14/day meal vouchers.

Expérience de l’ordonnancement de production, idéalement avec Control-M.

Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux et doté d’un bon esprit d’analyse.
Vous disposez d’excellentes capacités de communication écrite et orale.

jobs.title: Software Data Engineer (AWS)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Data Engineer (AWS) based in France.

As a Software Data Engineer, you will contribute to the development of a modern data platform supporting manufacturing operations across a global industrial environment.

You will design and build scalable streaming and batch data pipelines that connect plant systems and enable reliable, data-driven decision-making.

The role combines cloud engineering, big data, data integration, and software development, with a strong focus on AWS technologies.

You will work with Kafka, Flink or Spark Streaming, lakehouse architectures, and Infrastructure as Code to transform complex data into production-ready solutions.

You will take ownership of solutions from initial design and prototyping through deployment, optimization, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

Working closely with international teams, you will help modernize legacy data solutions and contribute to broader digital transformation initiatives.

This is an opportunity to work with advanced data technologies while having a direct impact on the efficiency, reliability, and scalability of critical manufacturing data systems.

Accountabilities

Design and develop scalable streaming data pipelines using Kafka/MSK, Flink or Spark Streaming, and reliable routing into curated data storage.
Build batch transformation pipelines within a medallion lakehouse architecture, supporting bronze, silver, and gold data layers on Amazon S3 and using formats such as Iceberg and Parquet.
Design and manage data storage solutions across relational databases such as Aurora/RDS PostgreSQL, NoSQL technologies including DynamoDB, and object-based lakehouse storage.
Design, deploy, and maintain AWS infrastructure supporting data and machine learning workloads, using services such as EKS, Fargate, Lambda, S3, VPC, Aurora/RDS, and DynamoDB.
Take data solutions from prototype through to production by refactoring, optimizing, and applying software engineering, CI/CD, containerization, and deployment best practices.
Collaborate with international teams to gather requirements, contribute to solution design, and define effective data loading and ingestion processes.
Document technical developments, perform integration testing, and manage deployments within AWS environments.
Support the transition of completed solutions to the relevant support and governance teams, ensuring reliable operation and clear ownership.
Monitor production pipelines and ensure strong observability, data quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Participate in an application maintenance and support environment, investigating user-reported issues and implementing improvements to data ingestion processes.

Requirements

Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline; a PhD is considered a plus.
Strong programming and data engineering skills, particularly with Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience building streaming data pipelines using Kafka/MSK and Flink or Spark Streaming.
Practical experience with AWS services including EKS, Fargate, Lambda, S3, Aurora/RDS PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and VPC.
Solid understanding of big data technologies such as Spark, Hive, and HDFS, together with modern lakehouse formats such as Iceberg and Parquet.
Experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools, REST APIs, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Understanding of scalable data architectures, production data pipelines, data quality, monitoring, and operational best practices.
Experience with Iceberg or Delta Lake, change data capture (CDC), schema evolution at scale, or Scala is considered an advantage.
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams.
Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies, products, and technical capabilities.
Strong attention to detail, organization, prioritization, and time-management skills.
Ability to work independently while maintaining effective collaboration with technical and business stakeholders.

Benefits

Competitive compensation package aligned with experience, skills, and qualifications.
Gross annual base salary starting from €29,500, with the possibility of a higher offer based on the candidate's profile.
Employment contract governed by the applicable Gomma Plastica National Collective Bargaining Agreement.
Welfare and employee benefits package, with further details provided during the recruitment process and subject to applicable policies.
Restaurant meal/ticket benefits.
Flexible working hours.
Hybrid remote working model.
Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
Opportunity to work with advanced cloud, big data, AI, and digital transformation technologies in an international environment.
Inclusive workplace committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination.

— één beheerd platform waarop elke collega AI kan inzetten op basis van de eigen kennis van de bank en waarop elk team veilig AI-helpers kan bouwen. Jouw rol

Jij maakt de kennis van de bank bruikbaar voor AI — op een veilige manier. Je bouwt de ingestion pipelines die documenten, beleidsregels en dataproducten omzetten in beheerde, geclassificeerde en doorzoekbare kennis in Elasticsearch; je integreert met de datacatalogus van de bank zodat agents zich baseren op data met een bekende owner, classificatie en actualiteit; en je opent de toegangspaden naar de kernsystemen van de bank, voert data-analyse en -cleansing uit, zodat het platform echte operationele vragen kan beantwoorden.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Je bouwt de ingestion pipelines voor RAG-corpora: parsing (Office, PDF, images), chunking, embedding en indexing in dedicated Elasticsearch-clusters — waarbij de classificatie verplicht al bij de ingestion wordt toegepast.
Je voorziet alle geïndexeerde content van entitlement-metadata, zodat de retrieval kan filteren op wat elke gebruiker mag zien.
Je integreert met het datacataloguslandschap van de bank om beheerde dataproducten te ontsluiten, telkens met eigenaar, classificatie en actualiteit.
Je bouwt en monitort de data-quality- en lineage-checks op alles wat het platform voedt.
Je ontwikkelt de toegangspaden naar de kernsystemen en het mainframe-landschap als kennisbronnen (en later ook als consumenten).
Je werkt samen met de AI Engineers aan de kwaliteit van de retrieval: chunking-strategieën, index-design en hybrid-search-tuning.

Gewenste werkervaring en kwalificaties

4+ jaar ervaring in data engineering: Python en SQL, ELT-/pipeline-frameworks, data quality en lineage in productie.
Ervaring met Elasticsearch (of een ander search-/vectorplatform) op productieschaal; ervaring met embedding pipelines is een sterke plus.
Vertrouwd met data governance-concepten (classificatie, ownership, catalogi); DAMA-achtige of catalogue-tool-ervaring is een troef.
Ervaring met heterogeneous enterprise sources (SharePoint/Office, databases, message queues); mainframe data exposure is ee plus.
Ervaring in een gereguleerde sector is een troef.
Bachelor- of masterdiploma in Computer Science.
Talen: vloeiend Engels (werktaal); vloeiend Nederlands is een sterke troef (Frans is een pluspunt).

Praktisch

Contract van onbepaalde duur.
Bij Delen Private Bank geloven we dat aanwezigheid op kantoor bijdraagt aan sterke samenwerking en betrokkenheid. Je werkt dagelijks vanuit ons kantoor in Antwerpen, met ruimte voor ad-hoc uitzonderingen wanneer nodig.

Wij bieden

Aantrekkelijke voorwaarden:
je ontvangt een competitief salaris aangevuld met een uitgebreid pakket extralegale voordelen, zoals hospitalisatie- en ambulante verzekering, groepsverzekering, ecocheques, gsm met abonnement, optieplan, extra verlofdagen (bank holidays), Benefits at Work, restaurant met versbereide maaltijden, keuze uit bedrijfswagen of andere (mobiliteits)oplossingen via het mobiliteitsbudget.
Ontwikkelkansen & intrapreneurship:
jouw groei staat centraal. We luisteren naar je ambities en helpen je actief om stappen te zetten binnen onze organisatie. Via opleidingen, interne mobiliteit en intrapreneurship krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en nieuwe uitdagingen aan te gaan. Jij bent de architect van je loopbaan – wij zorgen voor de juiste ondersteuning.
Persoonlijke aanpak:
als familiebedrijf sinds 1936 geloven we in de kracht van een persoonlijke aanpak. Je werkt in een warme en betrokken omgeving waar je écht gezien wordt. Dankzij onze vlakke structuur zijn de lijnen kort en is de directie – inclusief de familie – bereikbaar en betrokken. Ideeën krijgen snel gehoor, beslissingen worden doortastend genomen.
Collegiale sfeer:
samenwerken zit in ons DNA. Je komt terecht in een hecht team waar collega’s elkaar ondersteunen, kennis delen en elkaar motiveren. We werken in een open en toegankelijke sfeer aan gedeelde doelen – met succes én met ruimte voor humor.
Duurzame samenwerking:
we bouwen aan relaties voor de lange termijn – met onze klanten én onze medewerkers. Ons zeer laag personeelsverloop is daar het bewijs van. Dankzij een cultuur van vertrouwen, open communicatie en stabiliteit krijg je de kans om samen met ons te groeien.

(Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde).

Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts :

Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté.
Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme.
Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone…
Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous…

Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques.

Profil / Mission

Au sein d’une industrie qu’elle soit Retail, Luxe, pure player, tourisme ou autre, la Data est au cœur de l’activité.

En effet, il s’agit de maîtriser une architecture Data Centrics, plateforme de référence Data qui fournit des données en temps réel (via API) pour simplifier et accélérer les prises de décisions tech, business et digitales.

Davidson dispose d’un savoir-faire reconnu qui lui permet d’intervenir sur différentes phases d’un projet que ce soit en Conseil et organisation, Cadrage, Définition, Conception ou Optimisation. Nos consultants interviennent sur des projets Data ingénieur, Data Analytics et Data IA.

Ton rôle en tant que Data Engineer sera de contribuer à des projets Data :

Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données ETL/ELT sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Conception de data warehouses et data lakes scalables sur BigQuery, optimisation des schémas et partitions
Optimisation des requêtes SQL, gestion du partitionnement, réduction des coûts BigQuery/Dataflow
Versionning (Git), déploiement continu via Terraform, Cloud Build, GitLab CI
Nettoyage, normalisation, contrôle de cohérence ; mise en place de tests et monitoring des données
Stack technique :
Cloud : GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Composer, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Kafka)
Langages : SQL, Python, Java/Scala
Orchestration : Cloud Composer (Airflow), dbt

Exemples de projets menés :

Pour un client dans le secteur du luxe : concevoir et automatiser des pipelines de données scalables sur Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer) pour alimenter la personnalisation, les recommandations produits et les tableaux de bord business
Pour un autre client : concevoir et automatiser des pipelines de données scalables sur Google Cloud Platform à destination du département marketing digital ( ciblage et activation marketing au travers de campagnes de dernière génération, publicité digitale ciblée, etc.)

PUR Description

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects.
Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries.
We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods.
Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action.

About the role

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices.
Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem.

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines
using Python.
Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.
Design and maintain data models
supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.
Implement and monitor data quality controls
to ensure reliability and accuracy.
Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster
.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms
(preferably Azure).
Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code
practices (Terraform).
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.
Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.

We are looking for someone with:

3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering
, with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines.
Strong SQL expertise
and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.
Experience with workflow orchestration tools
(Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing
for data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms
(preferably Azure)
and Infrastructure as Code tools ( Terraform
is a strong plus).
Familiarity with AI tools
(Claude is a plus).
Strong knowledge of Git
and software engineering best practices.
Excellent problem-solving skills, focus on data quality and reliability, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
Fluent English
with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Interview with the recruiter
Interview with the manager and case study
References check

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique.

jobs.title: AI Data Engineer F/H/X
jobs.description:
About Teamwill Consulting

Putting domain expertise and artificial intelligence at the heart of the decisions that finance millions of projects, vehicles, and equipment around the world is the core of what we do.

For more than 20 years, Teamwill Consulting has been supporting leading players in banking, consumer finance, and mobility through their strategic and technological transformations. Operating in 11 countries and bringing together more than 800 professionals, the Group combines deep industry expertise, close client relationships, and the ability to deliver on a global scale.

Artificial intelligence is a cornerstone of our growth strategy. To carry that ambition, we are strengthening our technology, engineering, and data teams.

Role Summary

Teamwill Consulting’s Data Migration & Quality practice moves clients from legacy data platforms to modern, target architectures without losing trust in the data along the way: mapping, transformation, reconciliation, and lineage. As an AI Data Engineer, you build the pipelines and tooling that make that move safe and auditable, and you apply artificial intelligence (AI) to the parts of a migration that are normally the slowest and most error-prone, including high-level mapping, anomaly detection, and planning.

Key Responsibilities

Design and build data pipelines that extract, transform, and load data from legacy sources into a target platform, including moving business logic that lives inside a database (for example stored procedures) into versioned, tested application code. Build and maintain the ingestion and monitoring scripts, with clear logging and traceability, so a data issue in production can be traced back to its source.
Own and implement schema evolution and versioned database migrations, including moving from a shared database design to one schema, and one database, per service. Define accesses, rules, and controls for data, databases, schemas, and tables, applying the principle of least privilege, and work with Security and Infrastructure teams to enforce them.
Design and run data reconciliation and dual-run cutover processes: running the legacy and target systems side by side against the same data, to prove the migration is correct before the legacy system is retired.
Build and enforce data-quality controls (validation rules, anomaly detection, completeness and consistency checks) as an automated, repeatable part of every migration.
Apply AI, including large language models (LLM), to migration-specific problems: proposing a high-level data mapping between source and target schemas, drafting a migration test plan, and flagging likely anomalies for human review. Build the data pipelines and retrieval layer an AI-assisted mapping tool needs to reason over a legacy schema well: turning table and column definitions, constraints, and business documentation into a form a model can retrieve from accurately, and keeping that data clean, consistent, and current as the migration itself changes it.
Package data-processing components as containerized services with a documented application programming interface (API) and contribute them to Teamwill’s shared asset portfolio for reuse across engagements.
Work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Software Engineers, Platform Engineers, and client-side data owners to sequence a migration safely, including on live, regulated systems.

What You’ll Work On

You will work on data migration and modernization engagements for large-scale, regulated organizations in financial services. A representative engagement: a legacy system where part of business rules are embedded as stored procedures directly in the database, invoked from multiple call sites across dozens of services, which needs to move to a modern architecture without a single point of downtime and without losing an audit trail. You will also apply AI to accelerate the mapping, planning, and testing phases of this kind of work, in a production context where data residency, regulatory approval, and compute capacity shape solutions.

The work is international: you will collaborate with teams and clients across Teamwill Consulting’s geographies.

What We’re Looking For

Master’s degree (or equivalent professional experience) in computer science, data engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of hands-on experience building production data pipelines, including at least one large-scale data migration or platform modernization project.
Strong Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) skills; comfort writing tests for data pipelines (for example with PyTest) and treating data-quality checks as code.
Practical experience with schema as code and versioning tooling (for example Liquibase or an equivalent) and with relational databases at production scale (for example PostgreSQL).
Working knowledge of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), and of continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
Comfort working with AI tools, including large language models and AI coding agents, as part of an engineering workflow (for example for automated mapping proposals, test-plan drafting, pipeline code, and migration scripts), keeping a human accountable for migration decisions and applying review discipline (automated checks plus human review) to agent-produced code as to anyone else’s.
Software craftsmanship instincts and an Everything as Code mindset: pipelines, schemas, data-quality rules, and documentation are versioned, reviewable, and automated.
Professional fluency in English; professional French for roles based in France or Tunisia.

Nice to Have

Experience extracting business logic from a procedural database language (for example PL/pgSQL) into a modern application language, at scale, ideally in banking, capital markets, or another regulated financial-services sector.
Familiarity with event-driven architecture (for example a pattern such as Kafka and Debezium) and with change-data-capture (CDC) techniques for near-real-time data synchronization, useful for services that must be decoupled during a migration.
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a standard for connecting AI agents to external tools and data sources.

Location & Mobility

A minimum of 3 days per week, on site is expected, at Teamwill Consulting offices or at client engagement locations, with travel varying by assignment.

Teamwill fosters an inclusive work environment and ensures equal opportunity in all hiring decisions, regardless of gender, age, national or ethnic origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We know that finding the right job isn't just about the role, it's about what's in it for you, too. While we're a start-up, we're big on taking care of our people right from day one.
