Job Description

adesso Belgium, who are we?
We are an IT (start-up) provider working under the adesso umbrella with proven track record in different industries. The new Belgian entity of adesso
is part of the expansion and growth strategy of the adesso group. With more than 10.000 employees spread over 60 locations we are entering an exciting period with our presence in Brussels, the capital of Europe.

As part of adesso’s group ‘’grow together’’ mission, we want to attract talents who are ready for common growth. This means supporting the company’s vision, strategy, and growth in customers, industries, and, of course, the adessi community in Belgium.

Do you want to make data truly work
? At adesso, we are looking for Data Engineers who know how to translate complex data issues into scalable, efficient solutions. Someone who embraces cloud technology, but also understands that good data solutions start with understanding the process behind the numbers.

Job Requirements

As a Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer at adesso, you design and build modern data platforms on top of the Microsoft Fabric
ecosystem. You’ll work with the Fabric Lakehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks and Power BI to deliver robust, scalable and user‑friendly data solutions that enable our clients to become truly data‑driven.

You will join our growing Data & AI team in Belgium
, collaborating closely with experienced colleagues from adesso in the Netherlands and across Europe. You get the energy and influence of building a new practice, backed by the stability, knowledge and customer base of an established international group.

Your Role In Projects

Design & build Fabric‑based data platforms

Design and implement Lakehouse architectures in Microsoft Fabric, using OneLake, Lakehouses and medallion (bronze‑silver‑gold) patterns.
Build reliable batch (and where relevant streaming) data pipelines using Fabric Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2 and integration with Azure data services.
Model data for analytics use cases in Power BI (star schema, semantic models) and for advanced analytics in Lakehouses.

Ingest, transform & govern data

Ingest data from APIs, flat files, on‑premises and cloud databases, and SaaS sources into OneLake / Lakehouses.
Implement clear and testable transformation logic (data quality checks, deduplication, SCD, CDC, business rules) using Notebooks, SQL, Dataflows Gen2 or Warehouse features.
Apply data governance best practices (workspaces, roles, sensitivity labels, lineage, RBAC) across Fabric.

Collaborate with Data & AI teams

Work closely with data analysts, analytics engineers, data scientists and BI developers to make data discoverable and usable.
Expose data to end‑users through Power BI datasets, semantic models and reports built on top of Fabric.
Support advanced analytics / ML workloads by preparing and structuring data within the Fabric environment.

Operate & optimize

Set up CI/CD and deployment pipelines for Fabric assets (Power BI, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Datasets) using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub.
Monitor and optimize data pipelines, storage and workloads for performance, reliability and cost.
Help define and implement best practices, coding standards and reusable components for Fabric within the team.

Contribute to the Data & AI community

Actively share knowledge within the Belgian and Dutch Data & AI community at adesso (brown‑bag sessions, internal talks, blogs, PoCs).
Contribute to proposals and pre‑sales activities, helping shape new Microsoft Fabric engagements.
Coach and mentor colleagues, especially around the transition from “classic” Azure/Power BI stacks to Fabric‑based architectures.

Required Technical Skills & Knowledge

Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Apache Spark, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake, Python, PySpark, SQL

Your profile

Technical Skills

Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Fabric or a strong background in the Azure + Power BI ecosystem and the ambition to specialize in Fabric.
Good programming skills in SQL and preferably Python (for Notebooks and data engineering workloads).
Strong understanding of data modeling for analytics (star schema / dimensional modeling; data vault or 3NF is a plus).
Experience building data warehouses / data marts or analytical data stores that serve BI and reporting needs.
Familiarity with Azure data services like Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Lake or similar tools is a strong plus.
Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and software engineering best practices (version control, testing, code reviews).
Understanding of data governance, security and compliance in the Microsoft cloud (RBAC, sensitivity labels, PII handling).

Consulting & Soft Skills

You enjoy talking to stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating them into pragmatic data solutions.
You can explain complex technical topics in a clear and approachable way, adapted to your audience.
You are comfortable working in multidisciplinary teams (data engineers, data scientists, cloud engineers, domain experts).
You are proactive, hands‑on, and take ownership of the solutions you build.
You are native Dutch speaking and fluent in ENG (both written & spoken) French is a plus.
This position requires current residency and work authorization in Belgium; relocation from other continents cannot be accommodated.

The Offer Of The Data & AI Team

Growth & learning

A key role in building the Data & AI practice in Belgium, with a specific focus on modern Microsoft data platforms and Fabric.
Close collaboration with our Dutch Data & AI team, with access to proven architectures, accelerators and experienced peers in Azure and Fabric.
A personal development plan, training budget and support for Microsoft certifications (Fabric, Azure, Power BI).
Opportunities to grow towards roles such as Lead Data Engineer, Solution Architect, Analytics Engineer or BI Lead, depending on your ambitions.

Culture & way of working

A people‑oriented culture focused on collaboration, trust and entrepreneurship.
Short decision lines and the possibility to influence the technologies, standards and methods we adopt.
A hybrid way of working with a healthy balance between client‑site, office and home.

Why join adesso Belgium?

Meaningful work and projects: work within your domain of expertise where you can create value for customers and grow together with the company
Strategic opinion: your opinion and contribution to the expansion of the company is very valuable, it counts! You can give the company direction bringing in your ideas, creativity and vision for future growth!
GROWtogether: With over 400 training courses and our digital learning platform, we support your continuous development.

Global Reach with Local Expertise: you will be part of a small agile company where our culture code will drive us to success. As part of an international company we are supported in different domains with expertise and top notch reference cases!

jobs.title: Data Engineer H/F
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?…

Le contexte

Nos données, principalement constituées de documents normatifs PDF et XML et de leurs métadonnées, alimentent plusieurs services numériques et d’intelligence artificielle du Groupe.

Nos data scientists développent des services d’enrichissement, d’analyse et de recherche s’appuyant notamment sur la recherche sémantique et les architectures RAG. Ces services sont intégrés à des produits commercialisés et exploités en production.

Vos choix techniques ont donc un impact direct sur leur fiabilité, leurs performances, leur capacité à monter en charge et leur coût d’exploitation. Vous évoluez dans un environnement hybride, entre infrastructures on-premise et cloud.

Le poste combine conception d’architecture et mise en œuvre concrète : vous concevez, développez et industrialisez en Python et SQL les chaînes de traitement qui alimentent ces services.

L’équipe s’agrandit autour de nouveaux enjeux : intégration de collections internationales, évolution des modèles de données, montée en charge des services IA et industrialisation des chaînes de traitement.

Vos missions

Ingestion et alimentation des collections

Concevoir, développer et industrialiser l’ingestion des collections normatives (PDF, XML)

et de leurs métadonnées, y compris celles de partenaires internationaux.

Automatiser le suivi des évolutions des référentiels sources et réduire le délai

d’intégration de nouvelles collections.

Garantir la qualité, la traçabilité et le versionnement des données.

Développement et orchestration des chaînes de traitement

Concevoir, développer et industrialiser en Python et SQL les chaînes qui alimentent nos

services d’intelligence artificielle en production.

Orchestrer les traitements : extraction, parsing, transformation, appels aux API

d’enrichissement développées par les data scientists, puis chargement et indexation.

Garantir la robustesse des chaînes : reprise sur erreur, rejeu, idempotence et gestion

des dépendances.

Instrumenter les traitements et automatiser les contrôles de qualité des données.

Architecture et industrialisation IA

Concevoir et faire évoluer l’architecture des chaînes data alimentant nos produits et

services IA, en arbitrant entre performance, robustesse, évolutivité et maîtrise des

coûts.

Modéliser les bases de données et définir les contrats d’interface entre composants :

schémas, API et formats d’échange.

Définir avec les data scientists les contrats d’intégration de leurs services

d’enrichissement et les critères de mise en production.

Participer à l’industrialisation des usages IA : recherche sémantique, bases vectorielles

et architectures RAG.

Documenter les choix structurants sous forme d’Architecture Decision Records (ADR).

Référent data du pôle

Porter les sujets data auprès des architectes DSI, de la Sécurité et des Ops.
Assurer la coordination technique avec les partenaires internationaux pour l’intégration

de leurs collections.

Analyser l’impact des évolutions de données, d’API et de services sur les applications

consommatrices.

Ce que le poste n'est pas

Il ne s’agit pas d’un poste d’architecte uniquement : vous restez directement impliqué dans la conception, le développement, les tests et l’industrialisation des chaînes de traitement.

Vous ne développez pas les modèles ni les algorithmes d'enrichissement : c'est le rôle des data scientists, avec qui vous définissez les contrats d'intégration.

Vous n'assurez pas le monitoring d'exploitation ni l'analyse des logs, qui sont pris en charge par une personne dédiée. Vous travaillez avec elle pour que les chaînes soient observables.

Vous n'êtes pas responsable de l'urbanisation SI globale du Groupe ni du pilotage des livraisons produit.

Évolution du poste

Ce poste offre une trajectoire naturelle vers un rôle d’Architecte Data, avec une montée progressive en responsabilité sur les choix d’architecture, les standards techniques et la vision cible du domaine data.

Profil

De formation supérieure en informatique ou en data, vous disposez de minimum 3 ans d'expérience en tant que data engineering, dont une expérience de conception d'architecture de données.

Maîtrise de Python et SQL, et d'au moins un orchestrateur (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect ou

équivalent).

Modélisation de données relationnelles, conception et consommation d'API.
Capacité à formaliser et défendre des choix techniques auprès d'interlocuteurs variés,

techniques ou non.

Anglais professionnel requis (partenaires internationaux).

Atouts appréciés :
Expérience d'une plateforme alimentant des produits IA (RAG, bases vectorielles), pratique de l'instrumentation OpenTelemetry ou de l'intégration avec Elastic, notions de data quality et de lignage

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Un environnement stimulant : une mission d'intérêt générale , un collectif engagé, une expertise reconnue, une forte influence sur les politiques publiques et industrielles.
Un équilibre vie pro / vie perso : télétravail, horaires aménageables, mutuelle famille, dispositifs aidants, etc.
Des opportunités de développement : parcours de formation, mobilité interne, accompagnement individualisé.
Un employeur responsable : politique RSE ambitieuse, inclusion, égalité, accessibilité.
Une vie d’équipe dynamique : événements, activités culturelles et sportives via un CSE impliqué.

Informations complémentaires

Poste basé à La Plaine Saint-Denis (RER B, ligne 14)
Rémunération proposée entre 55 et 70 000€ brut annuel en fonction du profil

L’association AFNOR, chargée d’une mission d’intérêt général, constitue avec ses filiales un groupe international au service du développement durable. Le groupe de 1318 collaborateurs, 37 implantations dans le monde et 70 000 clients, conçoit des solutions fondées sur les normes volontaires, sources de progrès et de confiance depuis 1926. Sa vocation est d’accompagner les organisations et les personnes pour diffuser cette confiance. Un accompagnement qui s’effectue au travers de 4 domaines de compétences.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our team

Our data platform runs on AWS with Snowflake, dbt and Airflow, feeding an analytics layer in Power BI, and it is moving toward higher volumes and streaming ingestion. As our Senior Data Engineer, you will build the core of this platform and lead the Data Engineering team technically. Your work will cover ingestion, processing and transformation - from the source systems through to the datasets and data products the business uses - along with the production code, distributed processing and infrastructure the pipelines run on, and the engineering standard the team works to. You report to the Head of Data & AI.

You will

Own ingestion, processing and transformation end to end, maintaining pipelines as software with version control, testing and deployment.
Engineer for scale, using distributed and parallel processing where it's needed and streaming ingestion where the use case calls for it.
Own the infrastructure the pipelines run on, managed as code, deployed and monitored.
Deliver documented, tested datasets and the semantic layer that analytics and reporting consume.
Work with Power BI specialists and analysts so data models match how the business consumes them.
Model data for reuse, shaped around how the business uses it, so more than one consumer can build on it.
Lead the Data Engineering team day to day - direction, code review, prioritization and mentoring.
Hold the team to standards for testing, modelling, deployment and infrastructure conventions through code review.
Build to the architecture and standards the architects set, and feedback where they need to change in practice.
Partner with operations and integration teams on how source data reaches the platform, including streaming and change data capture.

You have

Senior data engineering experience on platforms running at high volume in production.
Experience leading or mentoring engineers and setting the standard for a team's output.
A software engineering background alongside analytics and data delivery experience.
Hands-on experience building and running data workloads on AWS.
Production-level Python and at least one other language, with code that is tested, reviewed and deployed through a pipeline.
Experience with a high-volume parallel processing engine such as Spark or Flink, including performance tuning at scale.
Terraform experience is required, since the role owns the infrastructure, its pipelines run on.
Experience with integration and ingestion patterns - APIs, events, streaming and change data capture from operational systems.
Strong SQL and dimensional modelling, dbt in production, a cloud warehouse (Snowflake preferred), and orchestration in Airflow or equivalent.
A disciplined engineering practice: Git-based workflow, CI/CD and automated testing.

What's in it for you?

A versatile position with pronounced responsibility and variety in a strongly growing and innovative market leader, operating internationally with headquarters in Hoboken (Antwerp) and offices in the Netherlands and the UK.
The IT organisation is a driving force to support the strong growth and you will help shape it.
An open corporate culture where you can be yourself.
A competitive gross monthly salary in proportion to your experience, including the possibility of a company car, supplemented by fringe benefits such as meal vouchers, group and hospitalisation insurance, additional holidays, and staff discount.
Adventurous colleagues in an international and diverse team.
The opportunity to participate in our bootcamps (showers available) and various team events twice a week during the lunch break.

We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of age, background, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or belief. Your talent is what matters most.

jobs.title: ICT Data Engineer (Dutch required)
jobs.description:
VIB (Vlaams Instituut voor Biotechnologie) is an entrepreneurial non-profit research institute, with a clear focus on ground-breaking strategic basic research in life sciences and operates in close partnership with the universities in Flanders.

The ICT department at VIB ensures that assets, technology, information, and data are managed securely and efficiently. Our focus includes:

Supporting and improving the ICT infrastructure, including networks, hardware, and critical systems.
Enabling digital transformation initiatives across the organization.
Securing and supporting applications, information and data flows, and software integrations.
Helping researchers and support services work efficiently through modern, reliable digital services.

To strengthen our team, VIB headquarters in Ghent is looking for an ICT Data Engineer who will help build and evolve the data foundations that enable reliable reporting, analytics and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

About The Role

As an ICT Data Engineer, you play a hands-on role in turning data from different business systems and sources into reliable, reusable and well-structured data solutions and data products that support reporting, analytics and other data-driven use cases across VIB. Working directly with data, pipelines, transformations, models and code, you build and implement robust and scalable data solutions as part of your day-to-day work.

The role spans the full data lifecycle, from understanding source data through data ingestion, transformation and modelling to making trusted data available for analytical consumption.

You take hands-on responsibility to the development, implementation and continuous improvement of the data solutions and data products delivered by the team. As part of a collaborative team, you build and improve these solutions while ensuring they are maintainable, testable, secure, observable and designed for reuse.

You work closely with business analysts, reporting specialists and application teams to understand both the technical characteristics and business context of data. Together, you help translate reporting, analytical and operational needs into sustainable data solutions rather than solutions built around individual reports or isolated use cases.

Reporting to the Data Analytics and Reporting Architect, you will contribute to the continued development of our data platform and engineering practices, including data quality, automation, governance and maintainability.

Our current data platform is built around Microsoft Fabric and related Microsoft technologies, while strong data engineering principles and the agility to evolve alongside changing technologies and business needs remain equally important.

Your Responsibilities

As an ICT Data Engineer, you will:

Engineering & building data solutions

Develop and optimize scalable data pipelines and transformations across our institutional data platform.
Build and maintain integrations that reliably bring data from different applications, systems and other sources into the data platform.
Develop and implement data models for analytical consumption, applying appropriate data warehouse and lakehouse modelling principles.
Build and maintain reusable data products that can support multiple reporting, analytical and other data-driven use cases across VIB.
Write and maintain code where appropriate, while pragmatically using standard platform capabilities where these provide the most maintainable solution.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across pipelines, transformations and data products.

Quality and engineering

Build data quality into solutions through appropriate validation, testing, monitoring and error handling.
Ensure that data pipelines and products can be effectively monitored and that technical issues can be efficiently identified, investigated and resolved.
Apply sound software and data engineering practices, including version control, automated deployment, testing, documentation and reusable components.
Design and build solutions with performance, security and maintainability in mind.

Delivery & ownership

Take hands-on ownership of the implementation and quality of data engineering solutions, from understanding source data and requirements to building, testing, deploying, monitoring and continuously improving reliable data solutions.
Analyze technical challenges, propose practical solutions and implement them within the agreed technical and architectural principles.
Continuously improve existing data solutions by applying simplification, standardization and sound engineering practices to increase quality and maintainability.

Collaboration & continuous improvement

Collaborate with business analysts, reporting specialists and application teams to understand source data, business context and analytical requirements.
Contribute your engineering perspective to discussions around data architecture, modelling, performance, security and governance, and translate agreed principles into working solutions.
Share technical knowledge and experience with colleagues and contribute to common standards, reusable patterns and engineering best practices within the team.
Keep up with relevant developments in data engineering and help assess where new technologies or approaches can create value for VIB.

Your profile

You have several years of relevant professional experience in data engineering or a closely related technical data role.
You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree, or equivalent through experience.
You have a solid experience in designing and implementing data pipelines, transformations and data models.
You have a solid understanding of modern data platform concepts, including data warehouses and/or lakehouses.
You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable working with large and complex datasets.
You have a good end-to-end understanding of data solutions and how different components work together.
You are able to analyze technical challenges, propose practical solutions and take ownership of their implementation.
You take a pragmatic approach to building solutions and understand the importance of maintainability and reuse.
You enjoy collaborating with colleagues across technical and functional domains and are able to explain technical concepts clearly.
You are comfortable working in an environment where technologies and practices continue to evolve.
You are fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Your Skills And Capabilities

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an asset:

Modern cloud-based data platforms and their engineering capabilities, with hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric considered a strong asset.
Programming or scripting for data engineering, for example using Python or PySpark.
Software engineering practices such as Git, CI/CD and automated testing.
API-based and other application integration patterns.
Semantic modelling and business intelligence platforms such as Power BI.
Data quality, lineage and monitoring.
Data governance and security principles in modern data platforms.

Our offer

An open-ended contract.
Competitive salary based on experience and expertise.
A strong salary package with multiple benefits (e.g. internet allowance, meal vouchers, smartphone, hospitalization insurance, eco-cheques, group insurance, …).
You will work within an innovative, challenging and international working environment in the large life-sciences network of VIB.
We offer opportunities for personal development. Taking additional training and courses is certainly possible if relevant to the performance of the job.
Our offices are located at VIB headquarters in Ghent. Possibility of homeworking (2 days/week), with balance between working from a remote location and from the office. We are flexible regarding work location and working hours.
We are an organization that values diversity in backgrounds and in experiences. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also nationality, age, disability status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. VIB is therefore looking for candidates who share a passion for science that generates an impact on society and care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

How to apply

If you are interested in this challenging and rewarding opportunity, please submit your application via the online application form (https://jobs.vib.be/apply/137662), including CV and letter of motivation.

In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting@vib.be .

Follow us on LinkedIn.

en tant que Développeur ESB (JAVA) - Integration Developer!

KEYES
accompagne les organisations privées et publiques, en Belgique et en Europe dans leur transformation digitale en alliant expertise métier, maîtrise technologique et vision à long terme.

Nous accompagnons les grandes organisations, le secteur public, les acteurs de la santé et les PME dans chacun de leurs challenges digitaux: Infrastructure & Cloud Solutions, Cybersecurity Solutions, Business Software Solutions, Mainframe Solutions, Data & AI Solutions, Advisory Solutions, Staffing Solutions.

Plus d’info : www.keyes.eu

Votre mission

Keyes, acteur majeur de l’intégration de systèmes d’information, recherche un(e) développeur(se) ESB
capable d’intervenir tant en tant qu’employé(e) qu’en tant qu’indépendant(e). Le poste s’inscrit dans un environnement Java où les flux d’échanges entre applications sont orchestrés à l’aide d’un Enterprise Service Bus (MuleSoft, IBM Integration Bus, Red Hat Fuse ou solutions équivalentes). Le/la candidat(e) devra faire preuve d’une grande autonomie et d’un véritable esprit d’analyse afin de concevoir, développer et optimiser des solutions d’intégration dans des contextes fonctionnels et techniques complexes.

Vos responsabilités :

Analyse fonctionnelle et technique : recueillir les besoins métier, étudier les architectures existantes et proposer des solutions d’intégration adaptées.
Conception de flux ESB : modéliser les routes de messages, définir les règles de routage, les transformations de données (XML, JSON, CSV) et les politiques de gouvernance.
Développement Java : implémenter les composants d’intégration (adapters, transformers, services) en Java, en respectant les bonnes pratiques de qualité de code et de sécurité.
Mise en œuvre et paramétrage de l’ESB : configurer les connecteurs (HTTP, JMS, SOAP/REST, AMQP), gérer les endpoints, les queues et les topics, et assurer le monitoring des flux.
Optimisation des performances : analyser les goulots d’étranglement, ajuster le threading, le pooling et le caching afin de garantir les exigences de latence et de débit.
Tests et validation : concevoir des jeux de tests unitaires et d’intégration, automatiser les pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI) et valider la conformité aux exigences fonctionnelles.
Support et évolution : assurer le support de production, diagnostiquer les incidents, proposer des améliorations continues et documenter les solutions livrées.
Veille technologique : suivre les évolutions des plateformes ESB, des standards d’intégration et des pratiques DevOps afin d’enrichir les référentiels internes.

Un package salarial complet.

Des moments fun – foodtruck, barbecue, after work, family day,…
Diplôme d'études supérieures avec une spécialisation dans le développement d’applications ou équivalent par expérience.

Compétences techniques : maîtrise du langage Java (JDK 8 ou supérieur), connaissance approfondie d’au moins un ESB commercial ou open‑source (MuleSoft, IBM Integration Bus, Red Hat Fuse, WSO2, TIBCO, Dell Boomi, etc.), aisance avec les protocoles HTTP/HTTPS, JMS, SOAP/REST et les formats XML/JSON.
Analyse et résolution : capacité à comprendre des processus métier complexes, à modéliser des scénarios d’intégration et à proposer des solutions techniques robustes.
Autonomie : aptitude à travailler de façon indépendante, à gérer son planning et à prendre des décisions techniques pertinentes.
Méthodologies : expérience des environnements Agile/Scrum, des pratiques DevOps (CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes) et des outils de versioning (Git).
Communication : excellente expression écrite et orale en français (et très bon niveau en anglais) pour interagir avec les équipes fonctionnelles et techniques.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Node/TS)
jobs.description:
About MentionLab

People used to search on Google. Now they ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity what to buy and which brand to trust, and soon AI will buy for them.

MentionLab shows businesses how AI sees them: what AI engines say about their brand, how they compare to competitors, and which sources shape those answers. We're building the data and intelligence layer for AI Search and agentic commerce.

Born in Brussels and global from day one, we already serve leading brands directly and through major consultancies and agencies.

We're moving fast in one of the biggest shifts in how people discover information, and we're looking for people who want to build incredible things with us.

The Role

As a Senior Data Engineer at MentionLab, you'll own the data layer at the heart of our product. You'll design and run the pipelines that turn raw AI answers into reliable, structured data. You'll also build the ClickHouse models that power our analytics platform and partner deliveries. Our pipelines are built in Node.js and TypeScript, so this role suits a data engineer with strong software engineering skills. If you love analytical databases at scale, care deeply about data quality, and want to own meaningful parts of a product from day one, this role is for you.

What You'll Build

Own our data architecture end to end: ingestion, transformation, storage and delivery
Build and scale the pipelines that process what AI engines say across markets, languages and models
Design ClickHouse data models and queries that stay fast as volumes grow
Guarantee data quality through validation, deduplication, monitoring and backfills
Run high-throughput, queue-based processing reliably in production
Work mainly in TypeScript and SQL, with Rust for performance-critical processing
Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, standards and mentoring

The Stack

TypeScript (Node.js) and SQL, with some Rust;
NestJS with MikroORM and Knex on PostgreSQL;
ClickHouse for analytical workloads;
Redis for queue management (BullMQ + custom tooling for high throughput).

What We're Looking For

Technical Requirements:
5+ years of engineering experience, including building and running production data pipelines
Strong, hands-on experience with data modelling, query optimisation and performance tuning on an analytical database (ClickHouse strongly preferred)
Solid Node.js/TypeScript skills: our pipelines are written in TypeScript, not Python
Advanced SQL
Experience with queue-based or event-driven processing at scale (retries, idempotency, backpressure)
Comfortable working across both analytical and transactional databases
Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar)

What We Value:
Proactive mindset: spot issues, propose solutions, don't wait to be told
Comfortable with code reviews and constructive feedback
Care about data quality and code quality, but know when to ship fast

Nice to Have:
Rust experience, or strong interest in picking it up
Experience with NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis/BullMQ
Processing unstructured or multilingual text data (e.g. LLM outputs)
Delivering data to external consumers (APIs, exports, data feeds)
Infrastructure knowledge (Docker / Kubernetes, observability)
Previous startup experience

You'll Thrive Here If

You enjoy figuring things out and don't need hand-holding. You're comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities. You like collaborating and sharing what you learn. You're excited about AI and its impact on how people discover information. And you're AI-native: you don't just build AI products, you build with AI.

How We Work

Languages: French required. English working proficiency for documentation and some meetings. Location: Belgium-based (Brussels - hybrid). Permanent contract (CDI) - 38h/week.

What We Offer

Fair salary package including car/mobility budget and insurance
Small, ambitious team
A chance to shape the technical direction of the company
High level of autonomy with guidance when needed: you're not alone!

→ You'll hear back from us fast, positive or negative. We won't ghost you.

Important note : we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. This is a guide, not a checklist.

Brussel
///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

Je werkt bijvoorbeeld mee aan de transitie van een klassieke data toolset (data warehouse) naar een recenter platform op cloudera technologie (data lake).

Waarom zou de kandidaat voor deze functie moeten kiezen?

Je komt terecht in een uitdagende omgeving, in een team met een joviale en inclusieve cultuur waar je kan werken met moderne technologie. Bovendien bouw je mee aan een betere ondersteuning van de Vlaamse arbeidsmarkt

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Wat is het doel van de functie ?
Je zal een belangrijke rol spelen in een uitgebreide portfolio aan projecten die gepland staan om het bestaande dataplatform te vernieuwen en verder uit te breiden. Je werkt in een compact agile team met een scrum aanpak.
Je configureert de nodige ELT stromen in DBT en/of NIFI om data te transformeren
Je voegt data elementen toe aan de datavault met de Vaultspeed automator
Je stelt dimensionele datamodellen op om de gewenste datasets te ontwerpen.
Je schrijft SQL-queries om de gewenste datasets voor dataproducten te creeëren.
Je test en valideert dataproducten om de kwaliteit en integriteit te waarborgen en testbevindingen op te lossen.
Je documenteert de end-2-end oplossing
Je geeft ondersteuning bij problemen, performance issues en werkt mee aan procesverbeteringen- en optimalisaties.
Je verfijnt, samen met de functioneel analist, de gevraagde requirements voor een dataproduct en vertaalt deze naar een concrete oplossing.
Je evalueert de technische haalbaarheid, beheersbaarheid en kostefficiëntie van een dataproduct en stelt hieromtrent verbeteringen voor.

De 3 belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden :

Correct opbouwen van datapipelines die een oplossing biedt aan de beschreven user story
Zorgen dat de geschreven code correct getest en gedocumenteerd is.
Het scrum team versterken door een actief teamlid te zijn.

Wat zijn de belangrijkste taken?

Bouwen van data pipelines in moderne ETL/ELT tools zoals DBT en NIFI
Het onderhouden van het data platform van VDAB
Schrijven en uitvoeren van unit tests om de gebouwde code te valideren
Opvolgen en ondersteunen van de operationele processen in het team, inclusief oplossen van voorkomende bugs

Je hebt minimum 5 jaar praktische werkervaring als data engineer. Je kan bijvoorbeeld zelfstandig SQL-queries schrijven om testdata te selecteren of flows te begrijpen. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het maken en ontwikkelen van data pipelines in DBT.
Je hebt kennis van Nifi en Kafka.
Je bent thuis in GIT en weet hoe je metadata kan beheren. Je hebt ervaring met Hadoop en big data.
Bewezen kennis van CDP (Cloudera dataplatform) in een data & analytics context is een troef. Je kan die kennis staven door de nodige certificaties, relevante ervaring of een specifiek leertraject.
Je weet hoe datasets performant gemaakt kunnen worden.
Je hebt al kennis gemaakt met data load refresh strategieën en met CI/CD.
Je begrijpt de basisconcepten van Agile en Scrum.
Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen van applicaties of services in Python geeft jou net dat streepje voor op de anderen.
Kennis opbouw van een DWH en datamodellering (3e NV, data vault, dimensioneel)
Praktische kennis van javascript zien we als een plus
Event driven architectuur - begrijpen wat dit betekent op gebied van data
Je bent een echte teamplayer en sparring partner voor de functioneel analist en architecten, waar je sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (in het Nederlands) je helpen.
Je bent proactief ingesteld, houdt van een pragmatische aanpak en vindt het heerlijk na te denken over de data oplossingen van morgen.

Je werkt 2 dagen in Brussel, op wandelafstand van het station Brussel Noord.

jobs.description:
Orus is a European insurtech company that is growing fast and full of ambition. The idea was born from a simple observation: professional insurance is too complex and not very effective. Professionals don't know what coverage they need, how and when it applies, and often end up unprotected or poorly covered. Orus is therefore the insurance professionals have been waiting for: simple, fast, transparent, and above all human.

At the heart of our mission:

A simple and understandable user experience
Putting technology at the service of tomorrow's insurance

To achieve this, Côme, Tom and Samuel, co-founders of Orus, raised 25 million euros in a Series B round. This was also an opportunity to be backed by top funds and private investors, including the CEOs of Pennylane, Hiscox Europe, and Leocare. 💙

Why join us?

You'll grow within a fast-growing startup
A senior team with backgrounds at top startups (PayFit, Qonto, Alan, etc.)
In a supportive environment, which is particularly important at Orus
And we're already the French favorite insurtech, with 4.9 stars on TrustPilot :)

What We Offer

💸 BSPCE: every Orus employee is also a shareholder
💻 Laptop of your choice (Apple, Linux, or Windows)
☕️ Spacious offices in Paris's 9th arrondissement
👩‍💻 Flexible hybrid-work policy
✨ Health insurance with Sidecare
🍏 €9 Swile meal vouchers
🏝 25 days of paid vacation plus 10 RTT days

The role

The data we collect and transform supports decision-making across Orus, from insurance product design and underwriting to regulatory reporting and customer engagement. As the company grows, we need a data platform that remains reliable, well documented, and easy to use.

You will join as Orus's second Data Engineer and work closely with Davi, our first Data Engineer, as a peer. Together, you will increase the Data Engineering team's capacity, reduce its dependence on a single engineer, and improve the quality of its architecture decisions. You will contribute across the platform and progressively take ownership of significant areas as your understanding of the systems and business grows.

Your Responsibilities

Build and maintain a data quality and reliability framework using dbt tests, monitoring, clear ownership, and a defined severity model.
Improve the data development environment, including CI/CD for dbt, review standards, documentation, and data contracts.
Promote data culture and self-service by documenting tables, helping teams use data autonomously, and improving data marts for business needs.
Work closely with teams across Orus:
Partner with Analytics to build data marts that help the team create value from data.
Support Growth in using customer data for communication automation.
Partner early with Insurance and Engineering so data requirements, reporting models, and quality checks are ready before each product launch.

Proactively map and integrate internal and external data sources into the data warehouse, moving from reactive ingestion to a prioritized source roadmap.
Maintain and evolve event-driven data pipelines, mainly written in TypeScript and connected directly to the application backend.
Build and maintain a governed semantic layer that enables accurate AI-agent answers and faster access to business information across Orus.

What Success Looks Like

During your first 6–12 months, you will help the team:

Increase delivery capacity and reduce dependence on a single Data Engineer.
Put an operational data quality framework in place, with automated tests, monitoring, severity levels, ownership, and a clear response process.
Improve the dbt development workflow with reliable CI/CD, documentation, review standards, and appropriate data contracts.
Make event-driven pipelines more observable and maintainable while reducing technical debt.
Anticipate upcoming source-integration needs instead of responding only when requests arrive.
Enable business teams to find, understand, and use trusted data with less support from Data.
Extend the semantic layer so AI agents can answer accurately across more business domains.
Contribute actively to architecture discussions and take ownership of meaningful areas of the platform.

Technical context

Orus's product uses event sourcing: every change in the system is captured as an event. Our data platform ingests these events in real time and also integrates batch data from external sources.

Data stack

dbt Cloud — data transformation, documentation, and testing
BigQuery — data warehouse
MongoDB — main application database
TypeScript — event-driven pipelines connected to the application backend
Fivetran — external-source ingestion
Hightouch — reverse ETL
Metabase — data exploration and quick access
Looker Studio — main analytics tool for the Analytics team
Google Cloud, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Argo CD — infrastructure and production operations

External data sources

Our sources include HubSpot, Aircall, Teamtailor, Webflow, lead-generation partners, Meta Ads, Google Ads, and product-behavior data currently being migrated from Segment to PostHog.

Day-to-day work

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Shaping and prioritizing data requests with stakeholders.
Assessing data impacts with Engineering when the application or back office changes.
Communicating project progress, risks, and decisions clearly.
Monitoring data quality and resolving production issues.
Developing and improving SQL models.
Pairing with Davi and contributing to technical and architecture decisions.

Profile sought

We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer at mid-to-senior level. Candidates will usually have at least three years of relevant experience, but demonstrated scope, judgment, and autonomy matter more than tenure or a specific degree.

Must have

Strong SQL proficiency.
Hands-on experience with dbt.
Strong understanding of at least one modern cloud data warehouse, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or ClickHouse.
Ability to reason about data models and architecture tradeoffs.
Willingness and ability to learn TypeScript.
Strong interest in collaborating with other teams and understanding the business.
Ability to connect technical choices to business goals.
Autonomy, initiative, clear communication, and a willingness to seek feedback.
Experience working in a startup or scaleup data team, ideally in SaaS, fintech, insurtech, or another data-intensive product environment.
Residence in Île-de-France and availability to work regularly from our Paris office. Full remote is not available for this role.

Nice to have

BigQuery and Google Cloud experience.
Experience with event-driven architectures.
TypeScript proficiency.
Experience with MongoDB and/or PostgreSQL.
Python proficiency.
Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, or Argo CD.
Production experience with agentic data systems or semantic layers.

Career development

The role offers a path toward Senior and Staff-level individual-contributor scope, with increasing technical leadership and ownership of the data platform without requiring a move into people management.

jobs.title: Senior Java ETL Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Our SynaptiQ platform collects near-real-time data from more than 20 million devices across thousands of utility-scale solar and wind sites worldwide. Everything the platform does — the analytics, the alarming, the reporting our clients run their portfolios on — depends on that data arriving complete, on time and correctly normalised. To keep that foundation solid as the portfolio grows, we are looking for a Senior Java ETL Data Engineer to own the technical direction of the engine that makes it happen.

You will join our Product Engineering organisation, working in a small cross-functional team of 2–3 engineers and reporting to an Engineering Manager. You will work closely with Product Management to define both what gets built and how it is implemented, and with Operations when things break. The working language is English. Day to day you will be in high-performance Java, S3-compatible object storage (S3, ABS, GCS), streaming infrastructure, and Linux.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will own the ETL engine — not a slice of it - and day-to-day:
You design, develop and operate the Java ETL engine that processes near-real-time data from millions of renewable energy assets. Ownership here runs from conception through to production operation: you build it, you run it, you fix it.
You architect and integrate the engine with S3-compatible object storage and streaming infrastructure. Deciding how and when we adopt a given storage or streaming technology is your call to make and justify.
You balance the technical trade-offs between real-time and batch processing, and make those calls on evidence rather than preference.
You take the lead on quality and reliability through code review, testing and SRE practice — including incident response and postmortem analysis when something goes wrong at 2am on a Sunday.
You decompose pipeline problems into actionable milestones and plans, so the team knows what "done" looks like before work starts.
You maintain the architecture decisions, runbooks and API documentation that let the rest of us operate what you build.

We are looking for someone who takes an idea all the way to production and stays with it afterwards. Someone technically rigorous, who writes high-performance concurrent Java and genuinely cares how systems behave under load at three in the morning. And someone pragmatic — who knows when to ship and when to slow down and do it properly.

To qualify as our ideal candidate:
You have 7+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years writing and operating high-performance Java in production.
You have a deep understanding of Java concurrency, parallelism and performance optimisation. This is the core of the job — the engine handles millions of devices, and naive code does not survive contact with that volume.
You have hands-on experience with data processing pipelines on S3-compatible object storage, and you are comfortable with Linux system administration.
You have delivered and operated production systems end-to-end — code review, testing, monitoring, incident response.
You are an architectural thinker. You evaluate technologies on evidence and guide the team toward sound choices rather than fashionable ones.
You hold a Master's in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent by experience.
You speak and write fluent English. It is our working language across engineering.
You can work autonomously: we don't have a micromanagement culture around here. Processes are light and we expect you to find information independently, ask for help when you need it, and improve the process rather than wait for one.
You can explain a technical trade-off to someone who isn't an engineer — Product and Operations need to understand the consequences of your decisions to make their own.

Bonus points for

Streaming platforms — Kafka, Flink or Pulsar
Time-series databases
Renewable energy sector experience

Our offices are hidden in the centre of Brussels with a view on a pond, with ducks and a heron bringing a regular visit. In addition to a stimulating atmosphere in a highly motivated group of people, 3E offers a unique opportunity to further develop yourself in a company/team with an ambitious growth plan, delivering innovative services.

environment with projects in over 100 countries worldwide, colleagues of over 20 nationalities.

jobs.description:
Description de poste

CGI Business Consulting, cabinet de conseil, éclaire les entreprises et les organisations dans leurs projets de transformation. Chaque jour, consultantes et consultants accompagnent nos clients dans leurs stratégies pour faire face aux mutations de leurs secteurs : nouveaux usages, performances des fonctions supports et opérationnelles, innovations digitales, sécurisation des activités, maîtrise des risques et conduite du changement.

Vous êtes spécialiste en DATA/IA et souhaitez rejoindre une équipe audacieuse à Paris, cette annonce est faite pour vous !

Fonctions et responsabilités

Intégré(e) au sein de nos équipes pluridisciplinaires composées de Consultants Data & IA, d’experts Data Science , Data Engineers, Data Architects et d’experts métiers ou sectoriels, vous participerez à des missions d’accompagnement de nos clients afin de réaliser des projets Data & IA complexes sur les volets techniques et scientifiques et construire des solutions innovantes.

En tant qu’expert en Data Engineering vous intervenez sur la conception et la réalisation de produits Data & IA en développant des flux, modèles et architectures robustes et scalables au service de cas d’usage métiers impactant en vous appuyant sur vos compétences en intégration, gestion, transformation et exposition des données.

En tant que Manager, vous serez amenés à piloter des travaux et encadrer des consultants pour délivrer des prestations de conseil en Data Engineering :

Acquérir, analyser et traiter des données pour la visualisation ou le machine learning
Développer et automatiser les flux de données depuis la collecte et l’intégration jusqu’aux différents traitements de Machin Learning
Construire des pipelines de données (ETL, APIs,..) robustes et évolutifs.
Choisir les technologiques les plus adaptées pour construire des solutions et architectures cohérentes et accompagner nos clients dans les arbitrages techniques et scientifiques.
Concevoir, mettre en place, maintenir et optimiser le stockage de données (DataWarehouse, Data LakeHouse,..).
Appliquer les bonnes pratiques de surveillance et de documentation des flux de données et des modèles ML.
Construire, configurer et gérer des bases de données (relationnelles, NoSQL,..).
Participer à la construction de pipeline CI/CD pour l’entrainement et le déploiement de modèles d’IA / GenAI (DevOps, MLOps).
Assurer la mise en place et le respect de processus garantissant la qualité, la cohérence et l’intégrité des données et des modèles.
Vérifier et gérer le cycle de vie de la donnée conformément aux bonnes pratiques techniques et scientifiques, au-delà des contraintes règlementaires et légales.
Formuler des recommandations techniques et technologiques pour alimenter des feuilles de routes Data & IA

En complément, vous serez amenés à participer activement au développement des activités Data & IA du cabinet et de la practice :

Encadrer des consultants et les accompagner dans leur trajectoire de développement
Porter des offres et des briques d’expertise
Mener des travaux R&D IA pour développer de nouvelles méthodologies, solutions ou convictions et travailler au développement de nouveaux assets.
Contribuer à l’animation d’un collectif de Data Engineers et Data Architects pour partager les savoir-faire, méthodologies et connaissances techniques et scientifiques.
Animer des formations internes pour éduquer l’ensemble des populations du cabinet à la Data et l’IA.
Réaliser des pitchs clients, learning expéditions et retours d’expérience pour partager son savoir-faire et son expertise Data & IA.
Rayonner au sein de l’écosystème Data Science : Salons, Conférences, Hackathons, Tables Rondes,..
Participer aux actions de recrutement.
Contribuer à l’animation de la communauté IA.

En rejoignant CGI, vous bénéficiez notamment d’une offre complète de formations (techniques, métiers, développement personnel,…), de flexibilité grâce à notre accord télétravail (jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine), d’une politique de congés avantageuse (27 jours de congés payés, RTT, congés ancienneté et enfant malade,…) et d’un package d’avantages intéressant (régime d’achats d’actions, participation, CSE,...).

Qualités requises pour réussir dans ce rôle

De formation supérieure de premier rang Bac+5 (Grand école d’Ingénieur ou cursus universitaire) en informatique, data science, mathématiques appliquées, statistiques, ou disciplines connexes, vous bénéficiez d’une expérience en Data Engineering au sein d’une organisation ou d’un cabinet de conseil et / ou avez mené ou participé à des projets significatifs de Data Engineering ou de développement de solutions Data/IA.

Vous avez démontré les qualités attendues d’un Manager Data Engineer :

Vous êtes curieux et vous portez une passion pour la Data et l’IA.
Vous aimez faire face à des défis techniques, technologiques et scientifiques en participant à des projets complexes.
Vous êtes rigoureux, fiable et doté d’un bon esprit analytique.
Vous aimez travailler en équipe et challenger / être challengé.
Vous savez travailler avec différents profils : techniques, métiers, sponsors,..
Vous savez travailler en autonomie, être force de proposition et proposer des solutions innovantes.
Vous possédez un niveau d’anglais technique adapté.
Vous savez encadrer des consultants et les faire grandir
Vous savez piloter des projets et déléguer

Vous portez une expertise Data & IA, des compétences techniques et des connaissances technologiques :

Maitrise d’un ou plusieurs langages de programmation (Python, Scala,..) et des bonnes pratiques de développement (design patterns, testing, formatting versionning,..).
Maitrise d’outils et de plateformes de traitement de la donnée (Hive, Spark,..)

Maitrise d’outils de gestion et versionning de code (Git,..), des frameworks de documentation et des outils collaboratifs (Jira, Confluence,..).
Connaissances d’environnements distribués, notamment sur des plateformes Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake,..).
Connaissance de frameworks et bibliothèques IA (PyTorch, TensorFlow, MLFlow, Transformers, LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc ).

Connaissances en bases de données relationnelles (e.g. SQL Server ou MySQL).
Connaissance des technologies LLM, architectures et solutions associées

Chez CGI, nous cultivons un environnement de travail respectueux, où chacun peut trouver sa place et développer son potentiel.

Nous sommes engagés en faveur d’un recrutement inclusif, fondé sur l’égalité des chances et la non-discrimination. Cet engagement est reconnu par le Label Recrutement Inclusif, décerné par JobinLive.

Ensemble, en tant que propriétaires, mettons notre savoir-faire à l’œuvre.

La vie chez CGI est ancrée dans l’actionnariat, le travail d’équipe, le respect et un sentiment d’appartenance. Chez nous, vous pourrez exploiter votre plein potentiel parce que…

Nous vous invitons à devenir propriétaire dès le jour 1 alors que nous travaillons ensemble à faire de notre rêve une réalité. Votre travail crée de la valeur. Vous ferez évoluer votre carrière en vous joignant à une entreprise bâtie pour croître et durer. Vous serez soutenus par des leaders qui ont votre santé et bien-être à cœur et qui vous permettront de saisir des occasions afin de parfaire vos compétences et élargir les horizons.

jobs.title: Security Data Engineer — SIEM Operations and Automation for NATO with security clearance
jobs.description:
A multinational defence organisation runs its security monitoring on a large, distributed Splunk estate, and is looking for the engineer who will own it. This is the senior technical voice on log collection and detection tooling for a cyber security data team, not a ticket-queue role.

What You Would Be Doing

Acting as the subject matter expert for the monitoring platform and everything that feeds it — advising other teams, sizing changes and taking the technical lead on related projects.
Designing, deploying and maintaining distributed architectures, and keeping the whole estate installed, configured and behaving.
Watching every component, spotting abnormal behaviour early in system, security and application logs, and taking the technical and the non-technical action needed to clear it.
Keeping the service inside the performance targets agreed with the customers it protects.
Integrating external tooling, and proposing the improvements that keep the environment current instead of merely alive.
Writing up the business case and the implementation plan for change boards, then delivering the approved change with the other teams involved.
Producing documentation, procedures and design notes, plus technical and executive reporting and the occasional briefing to a senior audience.
Taking a turn on call, so that monitoring stays available when something breaks out of hours.

What you would bring

Hands-on time administering Splunk in a large enterprise — deployment, installation, configuration and maintenance — and real experience of distributed designs.
Expert-level background in log collection and security monitoring management, with the analytical habit of reading logs to diagnose rather than to confirm.
Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting, and comfort with regular expressions.
Scripting to take the repetition out of the work: Bash, Python or Ansible.
A solid grounding in computer and communication security, networking, and where modern operating systems and applications tend to be weak.
Clear technical writing and the ability to explain a complicated problem to people who do not share your background.
Nice to have: Enterprise Security, SOAR and UBA, custom parsers, Git, cloud log collection, and an industry certification such as CISSP, CISM or a GIAC.

jobs.title: Data Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description:
BEDRIJF:

Deze industriële speler opereert in een omgeving waar continuïteit, schaal en operationele precisie cruciaal zijn. Achter de schermen draait een complexe operationele context waarin data een steeds belangrijkere strategische rol krijgt. De voorbije jaren werd een sterk technisch fundament gelegd. Vandaag ligt de focus op de volgende stap: data niet alleen technisch goed organiseren, maar ook sterker verankeren in besluitvorming, governance en toekomstige innovatie.

De omgeving is complex, met verschillende systemen, processen en stakeholders die dagelijks op elkaar moeten aansluiten. Data speelt hier niet langer een louter ondersteunende rol, maar krijgt steeds nadrukkelijker een strategische plaats binnen de organisatie. De cultuur is nuchter, inhoudelijk sterk en gericht op lange termijn. Mensen krijgen ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen, ownership te tonen en zichtbaar impact te maken in een omgeving die volop in beweging is.

JOBOMSCHRIJVING:

Als Data Engineer bouw en beheer je het technische fundament waarop rapportering, analytics en toekomstige datatoepassingen steunen. Je houdt de bestaande data- en Power BI-omgeving betrouwbaar en beheersbaar en helpt tegelijk het nieuwe Microsoft Azure Data & Analytics-platform vormgeven. Omdat de doelarchitectuur nog in ontwikkeling is, krijg je ruimte om technische keuzes mee te bepalen en oplossingen daadwerkelijk te realiseren.

Een belangrijk deel van je rol draait rond Azure en cloudmigratie. Je bouwt en monitort schaalbare data pipelines, onderhoudt integraties en verbindt de bestaande on-premise SQL Server-omgeving met nieuwe Azure-diensten. Daarbij werk je onder meer met Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse Analytics en Azure DevOps. Ook API-gebaseerde of event-driven integraties en de verdere ontwikkeling van een Operational Data Store kunnen binnen je scope vallen.

Je analyseert technische en functionele datanoden en denkt kritisch mee over welke componenten on-premise blijven en welke naar de cloud evolueren. Je werkt nauw samen met data-analisten, businessstakeholders, applicatieteams en architecten. Voor grotere implementaties schakel je met externe partners: je formuleert technische verwachtingen, volgt de realisatie inhoudelijk op en zorgt ervoor dat kennis intern wordt geborgd.

Naast de verdere uitbouw van het Azure-dataplatform krijg je de mogelijkheid om je te richten op data science en AI. Deze toepassingen staan nog in een vroege fase, waardoor je kunt meedenken over de technische fundamenten en het platform geschikt helpt maken voor geavanceerde analyses, modellen en toekomstige AI-toepassingen. Heb je hier al ervaring mee of wil je je hierin verder specialiseren, dan krijg je de ruimte om dit domein mee vorm te geven en te professionaliseren.

JOUW PROFIEL:

Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig bouwen en beheren van Azure-dataplatformen.
Je beschikt over sterke hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure; Azure Data Factory is daarbij een essentiële technologie.
Je hebt ervaring met het bouwen, beheren en monitoren van datapijplijnen en integraties tussen cloud- en on-premiseomgevingen.
Je beschikt over een grondige kennis van SQL, datamodellering en ETL/ELT-processen.
Je werkt gestructureerd rond datakwaliteit, governance, monitoring en technische documentatie.
Je bent ondernemend, neemt initiatief en communiceert technische keuzes helder aan collega's, partners en niet-technische stakeholders.
Je kunt je zeer goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands en professioneel communiceren in het Engels. Ervaring met Python of data-scienceomgevingen zijn een sterke plus.

UNIEK KARAKTER:

Je komt terecht in een technisch sterke, operationele omgeving waar betrouwbaarheid en continuïteit centraal staan. De organisatie combineert een solide bestaand datafundament met een ingrijpende modernisering richting Azure. Daardoor werk je aan oplossingen die rechtstreeks bijdragen aan dagelijkse processen en betere besluitvorming.

Deze rol biedt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en inhoudelijke invloed. Je bouwt mee aan een platform waarvan de architectuur en standaarden nog worden vormgegeven, terwijl je kunt terugvallen op ervaren collega's, interne architecten en gespecialiseerde partners. Tegelijk krijg je een duidelijk groeipad: naast Azure-platformengineering kun je je verder verdiepen in data science en AI en mee bepalen hoe deze toepassingen duurzaam worden ingebed.

jobs.title: BI Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Location:
Brussels, Belgium
Company:
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) Belgium
Employment Type:
Full-time

Nature of the tasks

Create and maintain Enterprise Data Warehouses (EDW) and complex Business Intelligence Solutions (Data Lakes / Data Lakehouses).
Design modern Business Intelligence (BI) architectures (e.g., data lakehouse) for cloud, on premises, and hybrid environments, ensuring compliance with security and data residency requirements.
Gather and analyse business requirements specifically for data pipelines, storage, and reporting solutions.
Design and implement modern Extract, Transform, Load / Extract, Load, Transform (ETL/ELT) processes and orchestration workflows, incorporating data contracts and schema evolution management.
Implement and manage data virtualization layers to provide unified access to heterogeneous data sources while optimizing performance and security.
Design and implement data models (e.g., dimensional modeling) to support reporting and analytics, ensuring alignment with business requirements.
Design and build reporting and analytics applications, creating dashboards, KPIs, and self-service BI tools that deliver actionable insights to business stakeholders.
Design and optimize the physical database schema, including indexing, partitioning, and storage strategies, to balance performance, cost, and maintainability.
Conduct ongoing database performance analysis, tuning queries, optimizing resource utilization, and ensuring SLAs for latency and throughput are met.
Design and implement data quality frameworks and health monitoring processes that include data observability (lineage, freshness) and defined Service Level Agreements / Service Level Objectives (SLAs/SLOs).
Define and execute test programs for BI solutions, including data validation, regression tests, contract tests, and automated pipelines integrated into CI/CD.
Produce and maintain technical documentation (data dictionaries, lineage, design specifications, runbooks) to support transparency, governance, and audit readiness.
Perform deployment and configuration of BI systems and platforms, applying infrastructure-as-code, version control, and environment management practices.
Govern the BI semantic layer (KPIs, metrics catalog, naming conventions, row-level security) to ensure consistency and trusted insights.
Manage access controls and data security within BI platforms in alignment with GDPR and internal data protection policies.
Optimize cost and performance of BI platforms and warehouses (partitioning, caching, clustering, query optimization, resource scaling).
Define and enforce data lineage and stewardship practices, ensuring transparency, auditability, and compliance.
Enable self-service BI capabilities for business users through curated datasets, certified reports, and training/support.

Specific expertise and technologies

Knowledge of enterprise data warehouse design and architecture, including dimensional modelling and star/snowflake schema design.
Knowledge of data lake and lakehouse design patterns (e.g., Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg) to support large-scale analytics.
Excellent knowledge of relational database systems applied to data warehouse.
Knowledge of non-relational databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra, Hadoop HBase) for handling unstructured and semi-structured data.
Excellent knowledge of SQL.
Knowledge of BI reporting and analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) for enterprise dashboards and self-service analytics.
Knowledge of ETL and ELT tools (e.g., Informatica, Talend, dbt, Azure Data Factory) to manage enterprise data pipelines.
Knowledge of modelling tools (e.g., ERwin, SAP PowerDesigner, ArchiMate for data flows) to design logical and physical data models.
Knowledge of OLAP technologies (e.g., SSAS, Essbase) and data mining tools (e.g., SAS Enterprise Miner, RapidMiner).
Knowledge of near real-time data ingestion and change data capture (CDC) technologies (e.g., Kafka, Debezium, GoldenGate).
Knowledge of cloud BI architectures (e.g., Azure Synapse, Snowflake, AWS Redshift) to enable scalable analytics.
Knowledge of data governance and cataloguing practices (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Azure Purview) to ensure trusted data assets.
Knowledge of data observability practices (e.g., freshness, lineage, anomaly detection) to monitor and assure pipeline quality.

Minimum level of expertise

Normal

Certification and/or Standards

Optional:
One of the following or an equivalent certification:
Microsoft Data Analyst Associate
Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate
Amazon Certified Data Analytics Specialty

Skills

Ability to apply rigour and consistency in BI development practices.
Ability to work in multi-cultural environment.
Ability to participate in multilingual meetings.
Ability to understand, speak and write English; one of French or Dutch is a plus
Talent for building relationships and adapting communication to the audience.
Ability to work in a team as well as autonomously.
Results-oriented mindset, focused on delivering.

jobs.description:
YOUR WORK ENVIRONMENT

Why AXA?

At AXA, we work together every day for human progress by protecting what matters. It’s a foundation of our actions, our strategy, and the way we collaborate across the Group. Every day, we contribute to human progress in a way that is practical, responsible, and meaningful, creating a shared sense of direction, commitment, and collective impact that connects people across teams, countries, and roles.

As one of the world’s leading insurers in the protection of property, people, and assets, AXA brings together 154,000 employees and contributors across 50 countries, serving over 95 million customers worldwide.

As a responsible corporate citizen, AXA is deeply engaged in social and environmental initiatives and actively promotes an inclusive culture where every voice matters, differences are valued, and everyone is encouraged to grow through our strategy Care and Dare.

About AXA Group Headquarters (GIE AXA)

AXA Group Headquarters (GIE AXA) brings together the Group’s corporate functions and plays a central role in shaping and driving AXA’s global strategy. It supports subsidiaries worldwide by ensuring strategic alignment, governance, operational and technical excellence, consistency of standards, and the sharing of best practices across the organization.

With nearly 1,000 employees representing 45 nationalities, the headquarters embodies AXA’s strong international culture and offers a dynamic, collaborative, and intellectually stimulating environment: where global impact meets everyday teamwork.

If these ambitions resonate with you, come and help shape the future of protection with us!

Your Role And Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

Building a centralized and reliable data pipeline

Collecting, cleaning, and inventorying nat cat claims data stored across various sources and formats (Excel, CSV, JSON, etc.)
Designing and implementing an ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipeline in Databricks to automate data ingestion, cleaning, and standardization
Applying data quality checks and validation rules to ensure accuracy and consistency of the data

Developing a user-friendly data loading/extraction interface

Creating an intuitive interface within Databricks (e.g., using Databricks Widgets or a notebook-based UI) allowing non-technical users to load/submit data with ease.
Implementing clear error messages and guided workflows to support data contributors across teams.

Enabling data visualization and self-service analytics

Building an interactive dashboard connected to the cleaned Databricks data layer, providing meaningful insights on the claims data
Integrating a data download feature, allowing authorized users to export clean, structured datasets directly from the platform

Documenting and maintaining the solution

Producing clear technical documentation covering the pipeline architecture, data dictionaries, and user guides
Following data engineering best practices (version control, modular code, reproducibility)

YOUR PROFILE

Who You Are

Education

Engineering or Master's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Data Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent)

Technical & Professional Skills

Programming skills in Python/R (pandas, PySpark) and/or SQL
Experience or strong interest in Databricks (notebooks, Delta Lake, workflows)
Familiarity with ETL pipeline design and data quality concept
French and Business English – fluent (spoken and written)

Interpersonal Skills

Autonomous and resourceful
Rigorous and detail-oriented
Strong communication skills
Curious and eager to learn about the insurance industry
Motivated by working in an international and dynamic environment

We encourage you to apply even if you do not fully meet all the qualifications listed.

At AXA, we are convinced that diversity is the wealth of our company. We ensure equal skills-based application review and accommodate specific needs.

What We Offer

An international work environment - over 45 nationalities present on site!
State of the art office spaces in the heart of Paris with remote work allowed.
60% reimbursement of Navigo pass
Generous Inter-Company Committee.
Company restaurant and meal vouchers.
And most importantly: a valuable experience within an active Early Talent community!

During the recruitment process, feel free to inform the recruiters about any specific adjustments you may need for your job.

WHY JOIN US

You Will Join

A responsible company, towards people, including its employees and customers, and towards the planet
A company with strong values
A company promoting internal mobility and the training of its employees
A company offering many benefits (learn more here: AXA Careers)
A flexible company, allowing hybrid work, in the office and from home.

In line with our commitments, we celebrate each new hire by taking action for global reforestation: we plant a tree for every recruitment. So, are you ready to apply?

AXA Group Headquarters (GIE AXA) is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA Group Headquarters, we know that an inclusive culture enables business growth and is critical to our success .

Mouratoglou Academy recherche un nouveau Data Engineering Manager (F/H), hands-on et orienté business.

Il sera rattaché directement au DSI, et prendra le lead sur l'équipe Data.
Les missions de ce Data Engineering Manager seront de :

· Comprendre les besoins business des différentes BU, les traduire en modélisation de solutions data et délivrer par itérations rapides les reportings opérationnels attendus (CA, remplissage, client 360, marketing, météo...)
· Structurer la gestion des projets Data (priorisation, planning, budget, livraisons), en assurer le suivi auprès de la DSI et du business, et accompagner les utilisateurs métier dans l'adoption des nouveaux reportings en remplacement des fichiers Excel manuels
· Reprendre et fiabiliser la plateforme et la modélisation métier existantes (datawarehouse, modèles dbt, documentation, qualité et observabilité des données) en s'appuyant sur les standards de modélisation, et produire et maintenir un data catalogue orienté cas d'usage pour rendre les données exploitables par l'IA (AI-ready data)
· Sécuriser la conformité RGPD des traitements data, dès leur conception (référentiel client unifié couvrant 2,5M de contacts), en lien avec la DSI et le juridique
· Piloter l'équipe Data (2 personnes) et se coordonner avec la DSI sur les sujets d'infrastructure et de production-readiness de la plateforme

Ce qui vous attend :
- Une plateforme en place mais pas finalisée : un existant technique incomplet et des priorités qui évoluent
- Un dialogue direct avec des opérationnels non-techniques de plusieurs BU

- avec une bonne maîtrise de la modélisation de données et une capacité à en garantir l'évolutivité et la justesse

- avec une forte sensibilité et un pragmatisme métier : capacité à dialoguer avec des opérationnels non-techniques (marketing, commerce, DAF) et à comprendre leurs enjeux avant de modéliser
- avec une méthode orientée « quick wins » et priorisation par usage métier, plutôt qu'une approche exhaustive ou centrée SI
- avec une capacité de management direct et de coordination transverse avec la DSI et les BU
- avec une sensibilité RGPD / conformité des traitements de données
- avec un usage actif des outils IA au quotidien et une veille personnelle sur les évolutions de cette technologie
- Une expérience dans un environnement multi-BU ou retail/e-commerce, avec l'habitude de délivrer du reporting business par itérations rapides
- Une expérience dans un secteur au modèle économique de type gestion de capacité/yield (hôtellerie, loisirs, transport, événementiel) et/ou une activité sensible à la météo

jobs.description:
About GitGuardian

GitGuardian is a global cybersecurity scale-up. The company is based in Paris, New-York City, Boston.

Among our early investors who saw our market value proposition, are the co-founder of GitHub, Scott Chacon, along with Solomon Hykes, Docker's co-founder. American and European top-tier VC firms have also invested in GitGuardian who raised its series C early 2026.

GitGuardian leads the way in securing the credential layer, helping organizations protect the secrets that let code, machines, and AI agents access systems with broad detection, identity context, and remediation at scale. Already trusted by 600K+ developers worldwide and by 50 of the fortune 500!

About Your Team And Your Mission

You will join the Data & AI Engineering team, whose mission is to build the data foundation and the internal AI-engineering capability that let GitGuardian run as an AI-native company.

The team works across three pillars. On the data side, we run the data platform, the business data models, and the ingestion chain behind every team's reporting and our product analytics, with the aim of data that is used, trusted, and increasingly near real-time. On internal AI tooling, we build the shared skills, internal MCPs, and the Analytics Agent, along with the governance and evaluation standards that make these tools safe to build on. And on apps, we maintain the internal app framework that lets anyone in the company ship an application to software engineering standards, with SSO, CI/CD, and managed hosting built in.

Data is already the backbone of the company's reporting and decision process. AI tooling and internal apps are newer ground, with real freedom to shape how all business stakeholders use data on the day-to-day.

Key Challenges

Build the data foundations for AI agents. AI agents are becoming the main way people query data. You'll help design the next generation of our warehouse and data models so that agents can understand them, trust them and answer questions correctly: clear semantics, well-documented metrics and structures built for machines as much as for humans.
Expand our data coverage to sensitive domains. Finance and HR data are joining our scope. You'll help bring them into the warehouse with the right level of rigor, access control and confidentiality.
Strengthen the existing data domains. Marketing, Sales and Product Analytics already rely on us. We want to make their data more complete, reliable and easy to use, on Snowflake today and ClickHouse soon.
Make data part of everyone's daily work. Our goal is for every team at GitGuardian to use Data & AI tools every day. That depends on trustworthy data models and clearly defined business metrics.

Own your topics end to end, from ingestion to consumption by business users.
Work with internal stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Product) to understand their needs and turn them into well-defined business metrics.
Build and orchestrate pipelines with Dagster, and deploy them with Docker and Terraform on AWS.
Take part in the run: monitor pipelines, investigate data issues, and answer data requests from across the company.
Keep the code base healthy through code reviews, tests and documentation.
Work closely with the squad's AI Engineers so that our data powers the company's internal AI tools.

Technical environment

Analytics databases: Snowflake, ClickHouse

Orchestration: Dagster

Cloud Provider: AWS
